A matching CCS is supporting evidence, not a unique structural identifier. Beyond the basics Connect the comparison back to annotation confidence and lipid structural specificity . Preserve raw mobility coordinates and processing provenance so a future reader can revisit the conversion and the claim.

title: 离子淌度与碰撞截面
summary: 区分实测淌度坐标与推导的 CCS，在明确气体、温度和校准背景下比较离子。
text: 增加一个气相分离坐标 离子淌度利用气相离子在电场作用下穿过气体时运动行为的差异进行分离。与质谱联用后，它提供 m/z 之外的信息：实测质荷比相同的离子，淌度可能不同。这一额外坐标可以帮助分离干扰或约束候选物，但不是分子的直接照片。应区分仪器观测到的坐标、由其推导的淌度以及进一步推导的碰撞截面。 [1] 本指南介绍如何理解这些量，以及如何负责任地比较它们。实例数值专为演示算术而构造，不代表某款商业仪器的规格或性能。 从运动到淌度 对于电场均匀、沿漂移方向的整体气流可忽略的理想漂移区，漂移速度 v d = KE，其中 K 为淌度，E 为电场强度。若有效漂移长度为 L，离子在该区域内的时间为 t D ，则 K = L/(Et D )。K 可用 m 2 V −1 s −1 或 cm 2 V −1 s −1 表示。这些公式需要恰当定义的漂移时间，而不是仪器记录的任意总耗时。 约化淌度 K 0 使用明确的参考值修正气体数密度：K 0 = K(N/N 0 )。应记录参考约定。密度归一化不能消除气体组成变化、碰撞行为的温度依赖性或约化电场 E/N 的影响。报告建议将这些条件视为被测量定义的一部分。 [1] 不同仪器观测不同坐标 漂移管离子淌度： 电场驱动离子沿充气区域运动。多电场测量可将漂移贡献与该区域外的传输时间区分开；也存在经过校准的单电场流程。 [2] 行波离子淌度： 移动的电势波输运离子。到达时间与淌度之间不是上述简单均匀电场关系；波参数和恰当的换算程序很重要。 [3] 捕集离子淌度： 电场与气流对抗，扫描电场时离子依次释放。释放坐标需通过仪器模型与校准转换为淌度。 [4] 差分淌度方法： 利用高场和低场下淌度的差异进行分离。补偿电压设定本身不是通常意义下的低场 CCS 值。 [5] 因此，标为“淌度”的坐标轴，可能表示到达时间、约化淌度的倒数或其他坐标。比较不同仪器上的峰之前，应查看单位和元数据。若没有必要模型，不要将漂移管公式套用于捕集离子的释放时间或行波传输时间。 实例：减去非漂移时间 假定理想均匀电场，L = 0.100 m，E = 10,000 V/m，实测到达时间为 52.0 ms。独立确定的其中 2.0 ms 属于漂移区外传输。因此 t D = 50.0 ms = 0.0500 s，K = 0.100/(10,000 × 0.0500) = 0.000200 m 2 V −1 s −1 ，即 2.00 cm 2 V −1 s −1 。 若直接代入 52.0 ms，则得到 1.923 cm 2 V −1 s −1 ，约低 3.85%。这说明时间定义的重要性，并不意味着所有实验都应减去 2 ms；实际修正取决于仪器几何和设置。本例中，若 N 等于明确选定的 N 0 ，则 K 0 等于 K；否则需乘以密度因子。 碰撞截面意味着什么 由淌度得到的 碰撞截面 （CCS，常记作 Ω）是通过物理模型推导的有效离子–气体碰撞量，通常以 Å 2 报告。它对离子结构和离子–气体相互作用敏感，并非中性分子的简单几何投影。在相容的低场条件下，其换算涉及淌度、电荷、温度、气体密度和离子–气体约化质量。 [1] 说明测量的是哪种离子：[M+H] + 、[M+Na] + 和 [M−H] − 是不同物种。它们的 CCS 不能作为“M”的条目互换。一项小分子漂移管原始研究在氮气中测量了多种离子形式，并用 CCS 进一步限制候选物。 [6] 若一种离子具有多个淌度峰，应保留分布，而不是无说明地用单一平均值替代。 比较条件相容的结果 解释 CCS 差异前，检查离子组成与电荷、缓冲气体、温度、电场范围、测量方法和校准来源。对于校准结果，记录校准物身份、参考值、拟合程序和验证范围。不要假设远离验证范围时，校准仍同样有效。漂移管跨实验室研究展示了标准化测量的价值，但其性能结果不能成为无关流程的准确度保证。 [2] 构造比较： 待测值为 202 Å 2 ，候选参考值为 200 Å 2 ，相对于参考值的差异为 +1.0%。能否接受取决于测量不确定度、参考值不确定度、偏差以及经过验证的匹配规则。“在 2% 以内”和“在 1% 以内”都不是通用鉴定判据。氦气参考值与氮气待测值，即使用相同的 Å 2 单位，也不应视为可直接互换。 分离不等于完整鉴定 某些异构体能够分开；另一些在现有分辨本领下仍重叠。单个淌度峰不能证明样品纯净。多个峰可能来自不同化合物、构象或质子化位点群体，需要额外证据区分这些解释。离子源和传输条件也可能改变进入淌度区的离子。因此，在利用气相结构推断溶液结构前，需要先解释气相结构本身。 [1] 应将淌度与准确质量、同位素、保留时间和诊断碎裂结合使用。一致性可以缩小候选范围；出现不一致时，应先检查离子身份和测量可比性，再作化学结论。 检查你的理解 两个离子的 CCS 相同，就一定是同一种结构吗？ 不是。不同结构的 CCS 可能重叠，尤其在有限不确定度下。匹配的 CCS 是支持证据，而非唯一的结构标识。 进一步学习 将这些比较与 注释置信程度 和 脂质结构细节 联系起来。保留原始淌度坐标和处理来源，使后续读者能够重新审视换算和结论。

title: m/z
summary: The dimensionless spectral coordinate determined by ion mass and charge.
text: Definition m/z is the conventional horizontal coordinate of a mass spectrum. To calculate its numerical value, divide an ion's mass expressed in daltons by the magnitude of its charge number. The result is dimensionless. If x denotes that coordinate, m ion the ion mass, and z its signed charge number, x = (m_ion / Da) / |z| . [1] Polarity is reported separately: negative-ion spectra ordinarily still use positive m/z coordinates. The physical ratio of mass to electric charge, expressed in kg/C, is a different quantity. In the IUPAC 2013 convention, label the spectral axis m/z , without a mass unit such as Da. A simple example Constructed arithmetic: an ion with mass 600.0000 Da and charge +2 has m/z 300.0000. An ion with mass 300.0000 Da and charge +1 has the same coordinate. Therefore, a peak position alone cannot determine both mass and charge. Common confusion The mass in this calculation belongs to the ion . It is not automatically the neutral molecule's mass. Adding protons or sodium changes the ion's composition before division by charge. Peak height reports signal intensity; it does not supply the missing charge number. Use it in a Guide Set up ion-mass and charge calculations Recover neutral mass from an explicit ion assignment

title: m/z（质荷比）
summary: 由离子质量与电荷共同确定的无量纲谱图坐标。
text: 定义 m/z （质荷比） 是质谱图惯用的横坐标。计算其数值时，将以道尔顿表示的离子质量除以电荷数的绝对值，结果是无量纲量。令 x 表示该坐标， m ion 表示离子质量， z 表示带符号的电荷数，则 x = (m_ion / Da) / |z| 。 [1] 极性应另行注明：负离子质谱图通常仍使用正的 m/z 坐标。以 kg/C 表示的物理量“质量与电荷之比”与此不同。按照 IUPAC 2013 年的约定，谱图横轴应标为 m/z ，不附加 Da 等质量单位。 简单示例 构造的算例： 质量为 600.0000 Da、带 +2 电荷的离子，其 m/z 为 300.0000。质量为 300.0000 Da、带 +1 电荷的离子也具有相同坐标。因此，仅凭峰位置无法同时确定质量和电荷。 常见混淆 计算中的质量属于 离子 ，不能直接当作中性分子的质量。加合质子或钠会先改变离子组成，然后才按电荷数相除。峰高表示信号强度，不能补充缺失的电荷数信息。 在指南中应用 建立离子质量与电荷的计算关系 根据明确的离子归属反推中性质量

title: Charge state
summary: Read an ion's net charge and understand what isotope spacing can establish.
text: Definition An ion's charge state specifies its net electric charge in multiples of the elementary charge e . The signed charge number is z = q / e : +2 means a net charge of +2e, and −2 means −2e. Use the magnitude |z| when calculating the conventional m/z coordinate. [1] In [M+3H] 3+ , the superscript gives charge +3. In [2M+H] + , the charge is +1; the 2 before M counts molecule units. The ion formula and the charge answer different questions. A simple example Constructed spacing example: replacing one 12 C with 13 C increases ion mass by approximately 1.00335483507 Da. If corresponding peaks have charge magnitude 4, their m/z separation is 1.00335483507 / 4 ≈ 0.250839 . This calculation uses NIST isotope masses. [2] Several consistent spacings near 0.250839 can support |z| = 4. They do not reveal the sign, adduct, or molecular identity. Overlapping patterns and missed peaks can mislead the assignment. Common confusion Charge state is the net charge of the whole ion , not an atom's oxidation state or a count of every locally charged group. Nor does +3 necessarily mean that three protons were added: that interpretation requires the specific [M+3H] 3+ model. Use it in a Guide Infer charge from an isotope pattern Read ion composition and charge separately

title: 电荷态
summary: 读取离子的净电荷，理解同位素峰间距能够提供的证据。
text: 定义 离子的 电荷态 表示其净电荷是元电荷 e 的多少倍。带符号的电荷数为 z = q / e ：+2 表示净电荷为 +2e，−2 表示净电荷为 −2e。计算惯用的 m/z 坐标时，使用其绝对值 |z| 。 [1] 在 [M+3H] 3+ 中，右上角标表示 +3 电荷。在 [2M+H] + 中，电荷为 +1；M 前面的 2 表示分子单元的数量。离子式和电荷分别回答不同的问题。 简单示例 构造的峰间距示例： 用一个 13 C 替换一个 12 C，会使离子质量增加约 1.00335483507 Da。如果对应峰的电荷数绝对值为 4，则其 m/z 间距为 1.00335483507 / 4 ≈ 0.250839 。此计算采用 NIST 同位素质量。 [2] 连续多个接近 0.250839 的一致间距可支持 |z| = 4 的判断，但不能给出电荷正负、加合形式或分子身份。同位素分布重叠或漏检峰都可能误导判断。 常见混淆 电荷态描述的是 整个离子的净电荷 ，不是某个原子的氧化态，也不是把所有局部带电基团逐个计数。+3 也不一定表示加上了三个质子；只有明确采用 [M+3H] 3+ 模型时，才有这种解释。 在指南中应用 根据同位素分布推断电荷 分别读取离子组成与电荷

title: Adduct ion
summary: An attached species changes ion composition and the mass correction you need.
text: Definition An adduct ion results when species associate to make an ion that retains the original constituent atoms and includes additional atoms. A familiar example is [M+Na] + : a neutral molecule M associated with a sodium cation. [1] The added species changes the composition to use in a mass calculation. Adduct formation can involve either polarity; for example, [M+Cl] − is a chloride adduct. For [M+H] + , the specific name protonated molecule is useful. [2] A simple example Constructed calculation: suppose M has a neutral monoisotopic mass of 200.000000 Da and forms [M+ 23 Na] + . The sodium-cation mass is approximately (22.9897692820 − 0.000548579909) Da = 22.989220702 Da , using the NIST neutral-atom mass and electron mass. Binding-energy mass corrections are neglected here. [3] [4] With charge +1, the predicted position is m/z 222.989221. Recovering M requires subtracting the sodium-cation mass, not the proton mass. This predicts a position if the adduct forms ; it does not predict its abundance. Common confusion A new peak need not mean a new compound: different adducts can originate from the same molecule. Conversely, a matching mass difference alone does not prove that two peaks share an origin. With M defined as a neutral molecule, [M−H] − describes proton removal, not attachment of an extra species; “adduct” is sometimes used more loosely in software menus. Use it in a Guide Compare common ion forms See how a wrong adduct changes recovered mass

title: 加合离子
summary: 附加物种改变离子组成，也改变反推中性质量所需的修正。
text: 定义 加合离子 由物种结合形成，保留原有组成原子，并包含额外加入的原子。常见例子是 [M+Na] + ：中性分子 M 与钠阳离子结合。 [1] 加入的物种会改变质量计算所用的组成。正、负离子模式都可以出现加合离子，例如 [M+Cl] − 是氯离子加合物。对于 [M+H] + ，使用更具体的名称 质子化分子 有助于明确含义。 [2] 简单示例 构造的算例： 假设 M 的中性单同位素质量为 200.000000 Da，并形成 [M+ 23 Na] + 。采用 NIST 的中性原子质量与电子质量，钠阳离子质量约为 (22.9897692820 − 0.000548579909) Da = 22.989220702 Da 。这里忽略结合能对应的质量修正。 [3] [4] 由于电荷为 +1，预测峰位置为 m/z 222.989221。反推 M 时应减去钠阳离子的质量，而不是质子的质量。这个计算给出的是 若形成该加合离子 时的位置，并不预测其丰度。 常见混淆 新出现的峰不一定代表新化合物：同一分子可产生不同加合形式。反过来，仅凭符合预期的质量差，也不能证明两个峰来自同一分子。当 M 表示中性分子时，[M−H] − 描述的是脱去质子，而不是附加其他物种；某些软件菜单会更宽泛地使用“加合物”一词。 在指南中应用 比较常见离子形式 理解错误的加合归属如何改变反推质量

title: Isotopologue
summary: The same molecular entity with a different isotope composition.
text: Definition Isotopologues are forms of the same molecular entity that differ in isotope composition. The element counts and underlying chemical structure remain the same; which isotopes occupy those atoms changes. The distinction applies to molecules and ions. [1] A simple example 12 C 1 H 4 and 13 C 1 H 4 are methane isotopologues. Each contains one carbon and four hydrogen atoms, but their carbon isotopes differ. From NIST's isotope masses, their calculated mass difference is (13.00335483507 − 12) Da = 1.00335483507 Da . [2] For corresponding ions with the same ion form and charge magnitude 1, this replacement shifts m/z by about 1.003355. At charge magnitude 2, the shift is half as large. These are calculated differences, not measured methane spectra. Common confusion Isotopes versus isotopologues: 12 C and 13 C are isotopes of an element; the methane species above are isotopologues. Isotopologues versus isotopomers: isotopomers have the same numbers of each isotope but differ in their positions. Their intact masses alone do not locate an isotope label. [1] Isotopologue versus peak: an unresolved nominal isotope peak, such as M+1, can combine different isotope compositions. One visible peak need not represent one isotopologue. Use it in a Guide Build an isotope distribution and understand nominal classes Interpret isotope ratios with stated assumptions

title: 同位素体
summary: 同一分子实体中同位素组成不同的形式。
text: 定义 同位素体（isotopologue） 是同一分子实体中同位素组成不同的形式。元素种类、原子个数和基本化学结构保持不变，变化的是这些原子采用了哪些同位素。这个概念适用于分子和离子。 [1] 简单示例 12 C 1 H 4 和 13 C 1 H 4 是甲烷的同位素体。二者都含一个碳和四个氢原子，但碳同位素不同。根据 NIST 的同位素质量，计算质量差为 (13.00335483507 − 12) Da = 1.00335483507 Da 。 [2] 如果对应离子的离子形式相同，且电荷数绝对值为 1，这次替换使 m/z 增加约 1.003355；电荷数绝对值为 2 时，增量减半。这些是计算得到的差值，不是实测甲烷谱图。 常见混淆 同位素与同位素体： 12 C 和 13 C 是某一元素的同位素；上面的甲烷物种是同位素体。 同位素体与同位素异构体： 同位素异构体（isotopomer）具有相同数量的各类同位素原子，但其位置不同。仅凭完整分子的质量，无法确定同位素标记的位置。 [1] 同位素体与峰： 一个尚未分辨开的名义同位素峰，例如 M+1，可能包含不同同位素组成的贡献。一个可见峰不一定只代表一个同位素体。 在指南中应用 构建同位素分布并理解名义类别 在明确假设下解读同位素比值

title: Monoisotopic mass
summary: A specific exact-mass calculation using the most abundant isotope of each element.
text: Definition Monoisotopic mass is a calculated exact mass that selects the most abundant isotope of each element in the specified molecule or ion. For many organic molecules, this means 12 C, 1 H, 14 N, and 16 O. “Most abundant” is the defining choice, not a general instruction to choose the lightest isotope. [1] Exact mass is the broader term: it can be calculated for any specified isotope composition. Therefore, every monoisotopic mass is an exact mass, but the exact mass of a deliberately heavy-isotope-labeled species need not be its conventional monoisotopic mass. [2] A simple example For neutral water with the conventional most-abundant isotope choices, (2 × 1.00782503223 + 15.99491461957) Da ≈ 18.010565 Da . These are the masses of two neutral 1 H atoms and one neutral 16 O atom from NIST. Chemical binding-energy mass corrections are neglected at this precision. [3] [4] Replacing 16 O with 18 O gives 1 H 2 18 O an exact mass of approximately 20.014810 Da. That is a different isotopologue, rather than a revised monoisotopic mass for ordinary water. Common confusion An isotope-weighted average mass answers a different question. [5] Nor does “monoisotopic” mean “the tallest observed peak”: the corresponding peak can be weak or undetected. A neutral monoisotopic mass is also not an ion's m/z ; ion composition and charge must still be specified. Use it in a Guide Compare exact, monoisotopic, and average mass See why the monoisotopic peak need not be tallest

title: 单同位素质量
summary: 选取各元素丰度最高的同位素所计算的特定精确质量。
text: 定义 单同位素质量 是一种计算得到的精确质量：对指定分子或离子中的每种元素，选取其丰度最高的同位素。对于许多有机分子，这意味着使用 12 C、 1 H、 14 N 和 16 O。“丰度最高”才是定义中的选择依据，不能一概理解为选取最轻的同位素。 [1] 精确质量（exact mass） 的范围更广：任何明确指定的同位素组成都可以计算精确质量。因此，单同位素质量属于精确质量，但人为重同位素标记物种的精确质量，不一定是按常规同位素选择得到的单同位素质量。 [2] 简单示例 对于按常规最高丰度同位素选择得到的中性水分子， (2 × 1.00782503223 + 15.99491461957) Da ≈ 18.010565 Da 。这里采用 NIST 的两个中性 1 H 原子和一个中性 16 O 原子的质量，在此精度下忽略化学结合能对应的质量修正。 [3] [4] 用 18 O 替换 16 O 后， 1 H 2 18 O 的精确质量约为 20.014810 Da。这对应另一个同位素体，而不是修订了普通水的单同位素质量。 常见混淆 按同位素丰度加权的 平均质量 回答的是另一个问题。 [5] “单同位素”也不表示“实测最高峰”：对应峰可能很弱，甚至未被检出。中性单同位素质量也不是离子的 m/z ；还必须明确离子组成与电荷。 在指南中应用 比较精确质量、单同位素质量与平均质量 理解单同位素峰为何不一定最高

title: Mass accuracy
summary: Separate closeness to the target from signed error, precision, and search tolerance.
text: Definition Mass accuracy concerns how closely a measured mass or m/z agrees with the value being measured. Following the metrological distinction in VIM, this entry treats accuracy as a qualitative concept and uses mass error for a numerical difference from a reference. [1] [2] Terminology varies: an IUPAC surface-analysis glossary uses “mass accuracy” for measured mass minus reference mass. Reports often quote a ppm error or error limit under that name. Check the stated statistic and conditions rather than relying on the label alone. [3] A simple example Let x obs and x ref be observed and reference m/z coordinates for the same ion form, charge, and isotope composition . Define the signed relative error as 10⁶ × (x_obs − x_ref) / x_ref , expressed in ppm. Constructed measurement: x obs = 250.0010 and x ref = 250.0000 give 10⁶ × 0.0010 / 250.0000 = +4 ppm . The positive sign means the observed position is higher. One such result does not establish a ±4 ppm performance limit for an instrument. Common confusion Precision describes agreement among repeated measurements under stated conditions. Tightly clustered results can all be displaced from the reference. [4] Resolving power concerns peak separation or width. A narrow peak can still be incorrectly positioned. Search tolerance is a chosen acceptance window; it is not a measured error, uncertainty estimate, or guarantee of correct identity. Exact mass is calculated for an isotope composition; the term accurate mass refers to an experimentally determined ion mass. [5] Use it in a Guide Compare width, error, and repeatability Convert ppm tolerances to matching windows

title: 质量准确度
summary: 区分测量的接近程度、带符号误差、精密度与检索容差。
text: 定义 质量准确度 关注测得的质量或 m/z 与被测值有多接近。本词条遵循 VIM 中的计量学区分，将准确度作为定性概念，将相对于参考值的数值差称为 质量误差 。 [1] [2] 不同资料的用语并不完全一致：IUPAC 的一份表面分析术语表将“质量准确度”用于表示实测质量减去参考质量。报告中也常以这个名称列出 ppm 误差或误差限。因此，应检查具体统计量和测试条件，不能只看名称。 [3] 简单示例 令 x obs 和 x ref 分别表示 相同离子形式、电荷及同位素组成 的实测和参考 m/z 坐标。带符号的相对误差定义为 10⁶ × (x_obs − x_ref) / x_ref ，以 ppm 表示。 构造的测量示例： x obs = 250.0010、x ref = 250.0000 时， 10⁶ × 0.0010 / 250.0000 = +4 ppm 。正号表示实测位置偏高。单次这样的结果，不能证明仪器具有 ±4 ppm 的性能限值。 常见混淆 精密度 描述指定条件下重复测量结果之间的一致程度。结果即使非常集中，也可能整体偏离参考值。 [4] 分辨本领 关注峰的分离程度或宽度；很窄的峰仍可能出现在错误的位置。 检索容差 是人为选定的接受窗口，不是实测误差、不确定度估计，也不保证身份归属正确。 精确质量（exact mass） 由指定同位素组成计算得到； 准确质量（accurate mass） 这一术语指实验测定的离子质量。 [5] 在指南中应用 比较峰宽、误差与重复性 将 ppm 容差换算为匹配窗口

title: Resolving power
summary: Interpret peak width and separation using an explicit criterion and reference m/z.
text: Definition Resolving power characterizes the ability to distinguish nearby m/z signals. A common single-peak convention is full width at half maximum (FWHM) : for a peak at coordinate x with FWHM w on the same coordinate scale, R = x / w . R is dimensionless. A larger value means a narrower relative peak width under that convention. [1] Measure w between the two half-height crossings of the profile peak, using a defined baseline. A centroid stick's drawn thickness is not the experimental FWHM. A simple example Constructed profile peak: x = 200.000 and w = 0.005 give R = 200.000 / 0.005 = 40,000 . Report this as “40,000 at m/z 200, FWHM,” together with the relevant acquisition conditions. A second signal 0.005 away is separated by one such peak width. That alone does not guarantee baseline separation: peak shape, relative intensity, and noise affect whether two signals can be distinguished. Common confusion FWHM versus valley: FWHM describes one peak; a valley criterion describes the overlap between two peaks. Numerical claims made with different criteria are not directly interchangeable. [1] Resolution versus resolving power: MS terminology has used both names for a ratio such as R. Always inspect the definition rather than assuming that one word universally means peak width and the other a ratio. [2] Resolving power versus accuracy: narrow peaks can still be offset from their reference positions. A high R does not by itself establish a small mass error. Use it in a Guide Interpret a resolving-power specification Compare peak width with position error

title: 分辨本领
summary: 结合明确的判据与参考 m/z，理解峰宽和峰分离能力。
text: 定义 分辨本领 用于表征区分相邻 m/z 信号的能力。一种常用的单峰约定是 半高全宽（FWHM） ：若峰位于坐标 x ，在相同坐标尺度上的半高全宽为 w ，则 R = x / w 。R 为无量纲量。在这种约定下，数值越大，表示相对峰宽越窄。 [1] 测量 w 时，应明确基线，并取轮廓峰两侧半峰高交点之间的距离。质心谱棒线绘制得多粗，并不是实验峰的半高全宽。 简单示例 构造的轮廓峰： x = 200.000、w = 0.005 时， R = 200.000 / 0.005 = 40,000 。应表述为“在 m/z 200 处，按 FWHM 定义的分辨本领为 40,000”，并注明相关采集条件。 如果另一个信号相距 0.005，这个距离相当于上述一个峰宽。但这并不保证基线分离：峰形、相对强度和噪声都会影响能否区分两个信号。 常见混淆 半高全宽与峰谷判据： FWHM 描述单个峰；峰谷判据描述两个峰的重叠程度。不同判据下的数值不能直接互换。 [1] 分辨率与分辨本领： 质谱文献中，resolution 和 resolving power 都曾用于表示 R 这样的比值。应查看具体定义，而不能假定其中一个词总表示峰宽，另一个总表示比值。 [2] 分辨本领与准确度： 窄峰仍可能偏离参考位置。高 R 本身不能证明质量误差很小。 在指南中应用 解读分辨本领指标 比较峰宽与位置误差

title: Mass analyzer
summary: The instrument component that distinguishes ions by m/z through their motion.
text: Definition A mass analyzer is the part of a mass spectrometer that distinguishes gas-phase ions according to m/z . Its operation connects ion motion with a selectable range or a measurable quantity, such as flight time or oscillation frequency. The ion source, analyzer, and detector describe different functions, even when closely integrated in one instrument. [1] The name does not imply a direct measurement of a neutral molecule's mass. Interpreting an ion coordinate still requires its charge and composition; see m/z and Charge state . One ion, different measurement routes Constructed ion: an ion with physical mass 800 u and charge-number magnitude 2 has the numerical coordinate x = 800 / 2 = 400 . A quadrupole can transmit the band around 400 at a chosen RF/DC setting. A TOF analyzer associates that coordinate with an arrival time. An Orbitrap associates it with an axial oscillation frequency. The coordinate is the same; the physical measurement differs. [2] [3] [4] Common confusion Analyzer versus source: ESI and MALDI describe ways of producing ions; TOF and Orbitrap describe analyzer principles. Analyzer versus instrument: a hybrid can use one component to select a precursor band and another to measure products. Read the component's job in the experiment. Selection versus identification: transmitting an m/z band does not identify one chemical species. Different ions can occupy the same band. Family versus performance: an analyzer name alone does not specify the achieved resolving power, mass error, scan timing, or useful signal range. Use it in a Guide Compare filtering, timing, trapping, and frequency measurement Follow the jobs in a hybrid instrument Connect ion measurements to chemical evidence

title: 质量分析器
summary: 利用离子运动按 m/z 区分离子的仪器部件。
text: 定义 质量分析器 是质谱仪中按 m/z 区分气相离子的部件。其工作原理将离子运动与可选择的范围或可测量的量联系起来，例如飞行时间或振荡频率。离子源、分析器和检测器描述的是不同功能，即使它们在同一仪器中高度集成。 [1] 这个名称不意味着直接测量中性分子的质量。解释离子坐标仍需要知道电荷和组成；参见 m/z 与 电荷态 。 同一离子，不同测量路径 构造的离子： 若离子实际质量为 800 u、电荷数大小为 2，则坐标数值为 x = 800 / 2 = 400 。四极杆可在选定 RF/DC 设置下传输 400 附近的范围；TOF 分析器将该坐标对应到到达时间；Orbitrap 则将它对应到轴向振荡频率。坐标相同，物理测量方式不同。 [2] [3] [4] 常见混淆 分析器与离子源： ESI 和 MALDI 描述产生离子的方式；TOF 与 Orbitrap 描述分析器原理。 分析器与整台仪器： 混合仪器可用一个部件选择前体范围，用另一个部件测量产物。应结合实验理解各部件的任务。 选择与鉴定： 传输某个 m/z 范围不等于鉴定出一种化学物质。不同离子可能落在同一范围内。 类型与性能： 仅凭分析器名称，不能确定实际分辨本领、质量误差、扫描时间或可用信号范围。 在指南中应用 比较过滤、计时、俘获与频率测量 理解混合仪器中各部件的任务 将离子测量与化学证据联系起来

title: Transient
summary: A finite time-domain ion signal, before frequency analysis and conversion to m/z.
text: Definition In Fourier-transform mass spectrometry , a transient is the time-domain electrical signal recorded from moving ion packets over a finite observation period. In Orbitrap and FT-ICR measurements, image-current detection provides an oscillating signal; Fourier analysis extracts frequencies that are converted to m/z . [1] [2] The transient has time on its horizontal axis. A frequency spectrum and a calibrated mass spectrum are subsequent representations of that record. This entry uses “transient” in the FT-MS detection sense; the same word can describe other time-varying signals in other contexts. Record length versus added zeros Constructed digital example: record N = 100,000 equally spaced samples at f s = 1,000,000 samples per second. Using the discrete-transform record-length convention, T = N / f_s = 0.10 s . The unpadded Fourier grid spacing is Δf_grid = 1 / T = 10 Hz . Recording 200,000 real samples at the same sampling rate gives T = 0.20 s and a 5 Hz grid. Appending 100,000 zeros to the original record also gives a 5 Hz computed grid, but the observed signal still spans only 0.10 s. The second operation interpolates the frequency representation. It does not supply the later ion motion that was never measured. Grid spacing alone is neither the peak's FWHM nor a guarantee of resolving two nearby frequencies. Common confusion Observation versus accumulation: accumulating ions and observing their motion are different stages. Transient versus cycle: the complete acquisition cycle may contain loading, selection, activation, and other steps; some operations may overlap. Duration versus guaranteed performance: the useful signal, analyzer conditions, and processing matter. Phase-aware processing has changed reported resolving power even at a fixed transient duration. [3] Use it in a Guide Understand image-current detection Connect observation time to acquisition timing Choose what evidence to acquire

title: 瞬态信号
summary: 在频率分析及 m/z 换算之前记录的有限时域离子信号。
text: 定义 在 傅里叶变换质谱 中， 瞬态信号（transient） 指在有限观察时段内，从运动离子包记录到的时域电信号。Orbitrap 和 FT-ICR 通过镜像电流检测获得振荡信号，再通过傅里叶分析提取频率并换算为 m/z 。 [1] [2] 瞬态信号以时间为横轴；频谱以及校准后的质谱图，是这段记录的后续表示形式。本词条中的 transient 限于 FT-MS 检测语境；在其他情境中，该词也可描述其他随时间变化的信号。 记录时长与补零 构造的数字示例： 以 f s = 1,000,000 样本/秒的采样频率，记录 N = 100,000 个等间隔样本。按离散变换的记录时长约定， T = N / f_s = 0.10 s 。未补零的傅里叶频率网格间距为 Δf_grid = 1 / T = 10 Hz 。 若以相同采样频率记录 200,000 个真实样本，则 T = 0.20 s，网格间距为 5 Hz。 在原记录后附加 100,000 个零，也会得到 5 Hz 的计算网格，但实际观察信号仍仅持续 0.10 s。 第二种操作对频率表示进行插值，并没有补上从未测量过的后续离子运动。网格间距本身既不是峰的半高全宽，也不能保证区分两个相近频率。 常见混淆 观察与累积： 累积离子和观察离子运动是不同阶段。 瞬态记录与周期： 完整采集周期可能包含装载、选择、活化及其他步骤，部分操作也可能重叠进行。 时长与性能保证： 有效信号、分析器条件和处理方法都很重要。即使瞬态时长固定，利用相位信息的处理也曾改变所报告的分辨本领。 [3] 在指南中应用 理解镜像电流检测 将观察时间与采集时间联系起来 选择需要采集的证据

title: Precursor ion
summary: The starting ion for a specified reaction, without an assumption of isolation purity.
text: Definition A precursor ion is the starting ion in a specified reaction that leads to product ions or a specified neutral loss. The term names a relationship in that reaction, rather than a particular chemical formula or instrument component. IUPAC's 2013 recommendations prefer precursor ion to the older term parent ion. [1] In a common product-ion MS/MS experiment, a mass filter or trap selects a window containing the intended precursor before activation. Isolation is an experimental operation; it does not make the precursor chemically pure or prove its identity. A simple example Constructed reaction sequence: A + produces B + in MS 2 . If B + is then isolated and reacted to produce C + in MS 3 , B + is a product in the first step and a precursor in the second. A, B, and C are placeholders; neutral coproducts are omitted from this role diagram, so it is not a balanced chemical equation. Common confusion A precursor need not be an intact molecular ion. It can be protonated, deprotonated, adducted, or already fragmented. Nor does one selected m/z guarantee one ion species: neighboring or overlapping precursors can generate a mixed product spectrum. This is demonstrated in primary peptide coisolation research. [2] Use it in a Guide Follow isolation, activation, and measurement Check what an isolation window contains Compare precursor-selection strategies

title: 前体离子
summary: 指定反应的起始离子；隔离并不保证其化学纯度。
text: 定义 前体离子 是某一指定反应的起始离子，该反应产生离子产物或指定的中性丢失。这个术语描述反应中的关系，而不是某个固定的化学式或仪器部件。IUPAC 2013 建议优先使用 precursor ion，而不是较早的 parent ion。 [1] 在常见的产物离子 MS/MS 实验中，质量过滤器或离子阱先选择包含目标前体的窗口，再进行活化。隔离是一项实验操作；它既不能使前体自动具有化学纯度，也不能证明其身份。 简单示例 构造的反应序列： A + 在 MS 2 中产生 B + 。若随后隔离 B + ，并使其在 MS 3 中反应产生 C + ，那么 B + 在第一步是产物，在第二步是前体。A、B、C 仅为占位符；这个角色示意省略了中性伴生产物，因此不是配平的化学方程式。 常见混淆 前体不一定是完整的分子离子，也可以是质子化、去质子化、加合或已经碎裂的离子。选中一个 m/z 也不保证只有一个离子物种：相邻或重叠的前体可以产生混合产物谱。原始肽共隔离研究展示了这一问题。 [2] 在 Guide 中应用 跟踪隔离、活化和测量 检查隔离窗口包含什么 比较前体选择策略

title: Product ion
summary: An ionic reaction outcome, including fragmentation or a change in charge.
text: Definition A product ion is an ionic outcome of a reaction involving a specified precursor ion. IUPAC includes reactions that change charge or involve another species, as well as dissociation. A fragment ion is the narrower case formed by dissociation of a precursor. [1] These labels are step-specific. A product selected for a later MS n experiment becomes a precursor for that next step. A surviving, unreacted precursor can appear in a product-ion spectrum, but that does not make it a new reaction product. A simple example Charge bookkeeping: electron capture can turn [M+3H] 3+ into [M+3H] 2+• . The electron is gained, all three added hydrogens remain, and net positive charge decreases by one. If the species remains intact, it is a charge-reduced product without being a smaller fragment. Intact charge-reduced products were observed in the original ECD work. [2] This schematic is not a measured spectrum or an exact-mass calculation. Common confusion A product ion need not have lower m/z than its precursor; charge changes matter. A neutral coproduct is not a product ion , and ordinary ion mass analysis does not give it a peak. Also, a peak in an MS/MS spectrum is not automatically proven to originate from the intended precursor: coisolated ions can contribute. Use it in a Guide Balance ion masses and charges Understand what product measurement records Distinguish product spectra from targeted transitions

title: 产物离子
summary: 离子反应的带电产物，可以由碎裂或电荷改变形成。
text: 定义 产物离子 是某个指定前体离子参与反应后得到的离子。IUPAC 所涵盖的反应既包括解离，也包括改变电荷或涉及其他物种的反应。 碎片离子 的范围更窄，指由前体解离形成的离子。 [1] 这些标签取决于具体步骤。将某个产物选出进行后续 MS n 实验时，它就成为下一步的前体。未反应的残留前体可以出现在产物离子谱中，但这并不使它成为新生成的反应产物。 简单示例 电荷核算： 电子捕获可以将 [M+3H] 3+ 转为 [M+3H] 2+• 。体系获得电子，三个附加的氢全部保留，净正电荷数减少 1。如果这个物种保持完整，它是电荷降低的产物，却不是更小的碎片。最初的 ECD 研究观测到了完整的电荷降低产物。 [2] 这个示意不是实测谱图，也不是精确质量计算。 常见混淆 产物离子的 m/z 不一定低于前体；电荷变化很重要。中性伴生产物不是产物 离子 ，常规离子质量分析不会为它记录一个峰。此外，MS/MS 谱中的峰并不自动证明来自目标前体，共隔离的其他离子也可能作出贡献。 在 Guide 中应用 核对离子质量和电荷 理解产物测量记录什么 区分产物谱与靶向监测离子对

title: Neutral loss
summary: An uncharged species leaves an ion; interpreting the mass gap requires a charge-aware reaction model.
text: Definition A neutral loss occurs when ion dissociation releases an uncharged species. [1] The residual charged product can be measured in an ordinary product-ion spectrum; the departing neutral does not produce its own ion peak. Its mass is inferred from an assigned reaction relationship. A simple example Constructed calculation: suppose a +2 precursor at m/z 301.100000 loses only neutral 1 H 2 16 O and remains +2. Treating NIST isotope-mass central values as fixed teaching constants without propagating uncertainties, water is 2 × 1.00782503223 + 15.99491461957 = 18.01056468403 Da . [2] [3] The coordinate decreases by 18.01056468403 / 2 = 9.005282342015 , giving product m/z 292.0947 after rounding. The starting coordinate is an exact teaching input, not a measured peak. Common confusion For a simple single-loss channel retaining charge magnitude n, neutral mass / Da = n × (precursor m/z − product m/z) . This assumes correctly assigned isotope compositions and no additional exchanged or lost species. It does not apply unchanged when the charge changes. An 18.0106 coordinate gap corresponds to about 36.0212 Da if both ions are +2. A compatible water-loss mass does not identify one structure or locate the original atoms. Nor does a matching gap between unrelated peaks establish a precursor–product relationship. “Neutral loss” names a process; the observed peak belongs to the residual ion. Use it in a Guide Compare +1 and +2 water-loss calculations Interpret losses within a full pattern Review charge-aware ion-mass notation

title: 中性丢失
summary: 离子失去不带电物种；解释质量间隔需要考虑电荷及反应模型。
text: 定义 中性丢失 是离子解离时释放不带电物种的过程。 [1] 剩余的带电产物可以在常规产物离子谱中测得；离开的中性物种本身不会形成离子峰。它的质量根据已指认的反应关系推断。 简单示例 构造的计算： 假设一个位于 m/z 301.100000 的 +2 前体，仅失去中性 1 H 2 16 O，且仍为 +2。将 NIST 原子同位素质量的中心值视为固定教学常数，不传播其不确定度，水的质量为 2 × 1.00782503223 + 15.99491461957 = 18.01056468403 Da 。 [2] [3] 坐标降低 18.01056468403 / 2 = 9.005282342015 ，四舍五入后产物的 m/z 为 292.0947。起始坐标是精确的教学输入，不是实测峰。 常见混淆 对于仅有一次中性丢失、且保持电荷数绝对值 n 的简单通道， 中性质量 / Da = n × (前体 m/z − 产物 m/z) 。这里假设同位素组成已正确指认，没有额外交换或丢失物种。若电荷改变，不能原样使用这个式子。如果两个离子均为 +2，18.0106 的坐标间隔对应约 36.0212 Da。 与失水相容的质量并不能确定唯一结构，也不能定位原先的原子。无关峰之间的匹配间隔也不足以建立前体–产物关系。“中性丢失”描述的是过程；观测到的峰属于剩余离子。 在 Guide 中应用 比较 +1 和 +2 的失水计算 将丢失放入完整模式中解释 复习考虑电荷的离子质量记法

title: Acquisition cycle
summary: A repeated measurement schedule whose duration determines when a channel is revisited.
text: Definition An acquisition cycle is a repeated measurement sequence. Its cycle time is the elapsed time from a defined point in one sequence to the same point in the next. For windowed DIA, an especially useful definition is the time until the same precursor window is measured again. [1] State which event is your reference when a method has several interleaved experiments. A cycle can contain one spectrum or many. DDA can limit the number of dependent scans or allocate a time budget, so a method label alone does not specify every actual cycle duration. [2] A simple example Constructed serial schedule: one 0.20 s survey, twenty 0.04 s window measurements, and 0.20 s additional overhead occupy 0.20 + 20 × 0.04 + 0.20 = 1.20 s . Assume no overlap between these blocks. There are 21 spectra per cycle, but only one measurement of any particular window. A consistently defined 12 s peak width gives 12 / 1.20 = 10 approximate opportunities for that window. This ratio is not an exact count, an identification count, or a universal quality threshold. Sampling phase and peak-width convention matter. The same planning ratio is used in targeted-method timing. [3] Common confusion MS2 describes an analysis stage, not cycle two. A scan's transient or accumulation setting is not necessarily the complete cycle time: some operations overlap, while others add overhead. Check the instrument's actual timestamps. [4] In DDA, a short cycle also does not guarantee that every precursor is selected for MS/MS in each cycle. Use it in a Guide Separate MS level, event, and cycle Work through the timing budget Connect measurement time to analyzer tradeoffs

title: 采集循环
summary: 重复执行的测量安排，其时长决定何时再次测量某个通道。
text: 定义 采集循环 是重复执行的测量序列。循环时间是从一次序列中某个明确位置，到下一次序列中相同位置所经过的时间。对于窗口式 DIA，一个特别有用的定义是再次测量同一前体窗口之前的时间。 [1] 如果方法交错执行多个实验，应说明以哪个事件作为参考。 一个循环可以含一张或多张谱。DDA 可以限定依赖扫描的数量，也可以分配时间预算，因此仅凭方法标签无法得知每个实际循环的时长。 [2] 简单示例 人为构造的串行安排： 一次 0.20 s 调查扫描、二十次各 0.04 s 的窗口测量，以及额外的 0.20 s 开销，共占用 0.20 + 20 × 0.04 + 0.20 = 1.20 s 。假定这些时间块之间没有重叠。每循环共有 21 张谱，但任一特定窗口只测量一次。 对于定义一致的 12 s 峰宽， 12 / 1.20 = 10 表示该窗口的近似采样机会数。这个比值不是精确点数，不是鉴定数，也不是通用质量阈值；采样相位和峰宽定义都很重要。靶向方法计时也采用相同的规划比值。 [3] 常见混淆 MS2 描述分析级次，不是第二个循环。扫描的瞬态信号或积累时间设置不一定等于完整循环时间：有些操作相互重叠，有些则增加开销。应检查仪器实际时间戳。 [4] 在 DDA 中，即使循环很短，也不保证每个前体在每循环都被选中进行 MS/MS。 在指南中应用 区分 MS 级数、事件与循环 逐步计算时间预算 联系测量时间与分析器的取舍

title: Isolation window
summary: The precursor m/z interval selected before an MS/MS measurement, with finite selectivity.
text: Definition An isolation window is the precursor m/z interval selected before an MS/MS measurement. Specify its boundaries or its center, full width, and any offset. A width of 1.2 means a total span of 1.2, not ±1.2, when the method uses the full-width convention. Confirm how the instrument defines the setting. [1] A simple example Ideal rectangular-window arithmetic: a center of 600.0 and full width 1.2 give 600.0 ± 1.2 / 2 = 599.4–600.6 . Model ions at 600.0 and 600.4 both pass. Keeping the center but using width 0.4 gives 599.8–600.2, excluding 600.4 in this idealization. An offset of +0.3 applied to the original width instead moves the bounds to 599.7–600.9. These are constructed coordinate tests, not measured transmission profiles. Real edges and transmission depend on the instrument and settings. Narrowing can exclude interfering ions but can also lose wanted signal. [1] Common confusion Isolation is not proof of chemical purity. Different analytes can fall inside one window and form a mixed product spectrum, even in DDA. [2] Ions with the same m/z cannot be separated just by narrowing this coordinate interval. An isolation window is also different from product-ion resolving power, a software extraction tolerance, and a retention-time scheduling window. In sequential-window DIA, narrower windows can mean more events to cover the same precursor range, linking selectivity to cycle planning. [3] Use it in a Guide Distinguish three kinds of window Calculate window count and cycle time Interpret coisolated precursor evidence

title: 隔离窗口
summary: 在 MS/MS 测量前选取的前体 m/z 区间，其选择性有限。
text: 定义 隔离窗口 是在 MS/MS 测量前选取的前体 m/z 区间。应给出边界，或中心、全宽及任何偏移。若方法采用全宽约定，宽度 1.2 表示总跨度为 1.2，而不是 ±1.2；应确认仪器如何定义该设置。 [1] 简单示例 理想矩形窗口计算： 中心为 600.0、全宽为 1.2 时， 600.0 ± 1.2 / 2 = 599.4–600.6 。模型中位于 600.0 和 600.4 的离子都通过。保持中心不变，把宽度改为 0.4，则边界为 599.8–600.2；在此理想模型中，600.4 被排除。若保持原宽度而施加 +0.3 的偏移，边界则移至 599.7–600.9。 这些是人为构造的坐标测试，并非实测传输曲线。实际边缘和传输取决于仪器及设置。缩窄窗口可排除干扰离子，也可能损失目标信号。 [1] 常见混淆 隔离不是化学纯度的证明。即使在 DDA 中，不同分析物也可能落入同一窗口并形成混合产物谱。 [2] 仅靠缩窄这个坐标区间，无法分离具有相同 m/z 的离子。 隔离窗口也不同于产物离子分辨本领、软件提取容差和保留时间调度窗口。在顺序窗口 DIA 中，更窄的窗口可能意味着需要更多事件覆盖同一前体范围，使选择性与循环规划相互关联。 [3] 在指南中应用 区分三类窗口 计算窗口数量与循环时间 解释共隔离前体的证据

title: Extracted ion chromatogram
summary: A time trace from selected m/z signals, with explicit extraction and scan filters.
text: Definition An extracted ion chromatogram (XIC or EIC) plots selected recorded m/z signal against chromatographic time. It is a chromatographic example of an extracted ion profile. [1] A spectrum has m/z on its horizontal axis; an XIC has time. Extraction usually includes a tolerance around the chosen coordinate. A total-ion chromatogram aggregates the selected spectra's broader signal, while a base-peak chromatogram takes the strongest peak at each time. These traces need not describe one compound. [2] A simple example Constructed centroid-data exercise: extract positive-ion MS1 data around m/z 600.000 with a ±5 ppm tolerance. The half-width is 600.000 × 5 / 1000000 = 0.003 , so the inclusive bounds are 599.997–600.003. This tolerance convention follows the documented relative-window calculation. [3] Invented signals in arbitrary units; each XIC point sums the included centroids Time / s Signal at 599.998 Signal at 600.001 Signal at 600.005 XIC sum, ±5 ppm 0 10 20 100 30 1 20 50 200 70 2 10 20 100 30 The 600.005 signal is excluded. Widening to ±10 ppm gives bounds 599.994–600.006 and sums of 130, 270, and 130. These numbers demonstrate selection arithmetic only; they do not identify any signal or validate an integration algorithm. Common confusion An XIC is a processing result, not an acquisition mode. Report the MS level, polarity, m/z tolerance, and relevant precursor/isolation filters. [3] An MS2 product trace should use the appropriate precursor-window events, not unrelated MS2 scans. Narrow extraction cannot recover unacquired data or undo precursor coisolation. A peak may combine unresolved or coeluting species; its presence or area alone does not establish identity or concentration. Centroid summation here is a teaching choice, not a rule for every profile-data implementation. Use it in a Guide Connect spectra to time traces Separate identification and quantification Review mass tolerance and measurement quality

title: 提取离子色谱图
summary: 从选定 m/z 信号提取的时间轨迹，需要明确提取条件与扫描筛选条件。
text: 定义 提取离子色谱图 （XIC 或 EIC）显示选定的已记录 m/z 信号随色谱时间的变化，是提取离子时间曲线在色谱中的一种形式。 [1] 质谱图的横轴是 m/z，XIC 的横轴是时间。 提取通常包含选定坐标周围的容差。总离子色谱图汇总所选谱中更广泛的信号，基峰色谱图则在各时刻取最强峰。这些轨迹不一定代表单一化合物。 [2] 简单示例 人为构造的质心数据练习： 从正离子 MS1 数据中，以 ±5 ppm 容差提取 m/z 600.000 附近的信号。半宽为 600.000 × 5 / 1000000 = 0.003 ，所以包含边界的区间是 599.997–600.003。这种容差约定遵循文档中的相对窗口计算。 [3] 虚构的任意单位信号；每个 XIC 点汇总区间内质心峰的信号 时间 / s 599.998 处信号 600.001 处信号 600.005 处信号 XIC 总和，±5 ppm 0 10 20 100 30 1 20 50 200 70 2 10 20 100 30 600.005 的信号被排除。若扩大至 ±10 ppm，边界变为 599.994–600.006，总和依次为 130、270 和 130。这些数字只演示筛选计算，不鉴定任何信号，也不验证积分算法。 常见混淆 XIC 是处理结果，不是一种采集模式。应报告 MS 级数、极性、m/z 容差及相关前体或隔离筛选条件。 [3] MS2 产物轨迹应使用对应前体窗口的事件，而不是无关的 MS2 扫描。 缩窄提取范围无法恢复未采集的数据，也无法撤销前体共隔离。一个峰可能混合未分辨或共洗脱的物种；仅凭其存在或面积不能确定身份或浓度。这里采用质心求和只是教学选择，并非所有轮廓数据处理实现都必须遵循的规则。 在指南中应用 联系质谱图与时间轨迹 区分鉴定与定量 检查质量容差与测量质量

title: Feature
summary: A detected LC-MS signal entity, whose grouping is not automatically a molecular identity.
text: Definition In this LC-MS context, a feature is a detected signal entity with an m/z position, retention time, and abundance measure. A workflow may combine an elution trace with compatible isotope traces and assign a charge. The grouping and reported abundance depend on the software's model. [1] State whether a table row represents a trace, an isotope group, a cross-run match, or a molecule-level summary. A simple example Hypothetical feature record: m/z 500.2000, retention time 300 s, assigned charge 2+, integrated area 120,000 arbitrary units. This is a compact signal description, not a peptide sequence or a chemical structure. The charge assignment and integration boundaries remain claims to inspect in the underlying data. Common confusion A centroid is a spectral-peak representation; an LC feature links or groups signal over the experiment. A compound can generate several adduct or charge-state features, while unresolved compounds may share a detected feature. Results formats therefore separate feature evidence from compound summaries. [2] In machine learning, feature can instead mean any predictor variable. That broader usage need not correspond to one LC-MS signal entity. Use it in a Guide Follow the path from spectral peaks to features Understand what was sampled

title: 特征
summary: 检测到的 LC-MS 信号实体，其分组并不自动确定分子身份。
text: 定义 在这里的 LC-MS 语境中， 特征 是检测到的信号实体，具有 m/z 位置、保留时间和丰度指标。流程可能将洗脱轨迹与相容的同位素轨迹组合，并指派电荷。分组方式与报告的丰度取决于软件模型。 [1] 应说明表格一行代表的是一条轨迹、一个同位素组、一个跨运行匹配，还是分子层次的汇总。 简单示例 假设的特征记录： m/z 500.2000，保留时间 300 s，指派电荷 2+，积分面积 120,000 任意单位。这是信号的简要描述，并非肽序列或化学结构。电荷指派和积分边界仍是需要在底层数据中检查的判断。 常见混淆 质心是谱峰的表示方式；LC 特征则在实验中连接信号或将其分组。一个化合物可产生多个加合物或电荷态特征，而未分开的化合物可能共用一个检测特征。因此，结果格式把特征证据与化合物汇总分开。 [2] 在机器学习中，特征也可以指任何预测变量。这种更广义的用法不一定对应一个 LC-MS 信号实体。 在指南中应用 理解谱峰如何形成特征 理解采集了什么

title: False discovery rate
summary: An expected error fraction for a defined set of discoveries, not a probability for every hit.
text: Definition The false discovery rate (FDR) is the expected fraction of false discoveries among all accepted discoveries. With V false discoveries and R accepted discoveries, write FDR = E[V / max(R, 1)] ; the fraction is zero when no discoveries are accepted. The expectation is over repeated data realizations under the procedure and its assumptions. [1] A simple example Hypothetical known truth: a list contains 100 accepted results, of which two are false. Its realized false-discovery proportion is 2 / 100 = 2% . One such list does not establish the procedure's FDR. In real identification tables, truth is usually unknown and an error estimate is needed. Common confusion A nominal 1% FDR threshold does not make each hit 99% likely to be correct, guarantee exactly one error per 100 hits, or imply a 1% chance of any error in the list. Proteomics target–decoy estimates depend on the search and counting rules. Specify the collection and level: PSM, peptide, or protein. Subgroup filtering, site localization, and tests of abundance differences raise separate error-control questions. [2] Use it in a Guide Separate scores, thresholds, estimates, and realized errors Explore a repeated-analysis teaching model

title: 错误发现率
summary: 针对明确定义的发现集合的期望错误比例，并非每条命中的错误概率。
text: 定义 错误发现率 （FDR）是所有已接受发现中错误发现所占比例的期望值。令 V 为错误发现数，R 为已接受发现数，可写为 FDR = E[V / max(R, 1)] ；没有接受任何发现时，该比例为零。期望针对的是在所用程序及其假设下，数据重复实现时的结果。 [1] 简单示例 假设已知真实情况： 某列表接受了 100 条结果，其中两条错误。其实际错误发现比例为 2 / 100 = 2% 。仅凭这样一个列表，不能确定程序的 FDR。在真实鉴定表中，真实情况通常未知，因此需要估计错误。 常见混淆 名义 1% FDR 阈值不意味着每条命中都有 99% 的正确概率，不保证每 100 条命中恰有一个错误，也不意味着列表中出现任何错误的概率是 1%。 蛋白质组学的目标–诱饵估计取决于检索和计数规则。应说明集合及其层次：PSM、肽或蛋白质。子集过滤、位点定位及丰度差异检验都提出各自的错误控制问题。 [2] 在指南中应用 区分分数、阈值、估计及实际错误 探索重复分析的教学模型

title: Missing value
summary: An unavailable result whose cause and handling require explicit assumptions.
text: Definition A missing value marks a result that is unavailable for a particular variable and sample under the pipeline's reporting rules. It does not itself explain why. Distinguish missing intensity, missing identification, a measured zero, and a result rejected by a filter. mzTab-M explicitly distinguishes no data from numerical values and discusses ambiguity introduced by feature finding or alignment. [1] A simple example Hypothetical table: areas [100, 100, missing] have an observed-only mean of 100. Zero replacement changes the calculation to (100 + 100 + 0) / 3 ≈ 66.7 . This is a changed assumption, not a newly measured third area. The observed-only mean is not automatically unbiased either. Common confusion Missing does not always mean absent or below detection. Signal strength, interference, acquisition, identification, and processing can contribute. Imputation estimates unobserved values; it need not improve the intended analysis. [2] Inspect the pattern and likely causes before choosing filtering, modeling, or imputation. Preserve missingness flags and measured values, and report sensitivity to plausible alternatives. No single replacement rule is a universal default. Use it in a Guide Reason about missingness before filling cells Connect acquisition choices to available evidence

title: 缺失值
summary: 不可获得的结果，其原因及处理需要明确假设。
text: 定义 缺失值 表示在流程的报告规则下，某个变量在某个样品中的结果不可获得。它本身不能解释原因。应区分强度缺失、鉴定缺失、实测为零以及被过滤器拒绝的结果。mzTab-M 明确区分无数据与数值，并讨论特征检测或对齐所引入的歧义。 [1] 简单示例 假设的表格： 峰面积 [100, 100, 缺失] 仅用观测值计算时，均值为 100。以零替换后，计算变为 (100 + 100 + 0) / 3 ≈ 66.7 。这改变了假设，并非新测得了第三个面积。只用观测值的均值也并非自动无偏。 常见混淆 缺失不总意味着不存在或低于检出限。信号强度、干扰、采集、鉴定和处理都可能造成缺失。插补是对未观测值的估计，不一定改善目标分析。 [2] 选择过滤、建模或插补之前，应检查缺失模式及可能原因。保留缺失标记和实测值，并报告结论对合理替代方案的敏感性。不存在普遍默认的统一替换规则。 在指南中应用 填补单元格之前先分析缺失原因 联系采集选择与可用证据

title: Mass spectrum
summary: Ion signal plotted against m/z, with a different horizontal axis from a chromatogram.
text: Definition A mass spectrum shows ion signal as a function of m/z . In the usual plot, the horizontal axis is m/z and the vertical axis is signal intensity. State whether the displayed spectrum is one scan or a combination of selected scans. [1] During chromatography, an individual scan describes a short time interval. An extracted ion chromatogram (XIC) instead follows selected recorded m/z signal over time. The same dataset can provide both views. [2] A simple example Constructed spectrum: at 2.0 min, three peaks lie at m/z 100.000, 200.000, and 300.000 with intensities 80, 40, and 20 arbitrary units. Drawing these three positions and heights gives one spectrum. The base peak is at 100.000 because its signal is largest. To draw an XIC around 100.000, keep that selected m/z interval and collect its signal from successive scans. A single spectrum cannot show its full time trace. Follow the three-scan example . Common confusion A peak position is an ion's m/z , not automatically the neutral molecule's mass. Several peaks can come from one compound, and one peak can combine unresolved ions. The tallest peak and a plausible mass alone do not establish identity or concentration. Use it in a Guide Read the axes and intensity scale Check the measurement context

title: 质谱图
summary: 离子信号随 m/z 的分布；其横轴与色谱图不同。
text: 定义 质谱图 展示离子信号随 m/z 的分布。常见谱图的横轴是 m/z ，纵轴是信号强度。应说明显示的是一次扫描，还是若干选定扫描的组合。 [1] 在色谱过程中，单次扫描描述一小段时间区间； 提取离子色谱图（XIC） 则跟踪选定的已记录 m/z 信号随时间的变化。同一数据集可以提供这两种视图。 [2] 简单示例 构造的谱图： 在 2.0 min，三个峰分别位于 m/z 100.000、200.000 和 300.000，强度分别为 80、40 和 20 任意单位。按这些位置和峰高绘制，就得到一张质谱图。100.000 处的峰信号最大，因此是 基峰 。 要绘制 100.000 附近的 XIC，就需要保持所选的 m/z 区间，从连续扫描中提取该区间的信号。单张质谱图无法展示其完整时间轨迹。详见 三次扫描示例 。 常见混淆 峰位置表示离子的 m/z ，并不自动等于中性分子的质量。同一化合物可能产生多个峰，一个峰也可能包含未分辨开的离子。最高峰及合理的质量匹配本身不能确定身份或浓度。 在指南中应用 读取坐标轴与强度尺度 检查测量背景

title: Base peak
summary: The strongest peak in a spectrum and the denominator for base-peak relative intensity.
text: Definition The base peak is the most intense peak in a specified mass spectrum . It is a signal ranking, not a chemical identity. [1] For base-peak relative intensity, use relative intensity (%) = 100 × peak intensity / base-peak intensity . The denominator is the largest peak intensity in that spectrum, so the base peak is 100%. It is not the sum of all peak intensities. [2] A simple example Constructed spectrum: peaks at m/z 100.000, 200.000, and 300.000 have intensities 80, 40, and 20 arbitrary units. The base peak is at 100.000, with intensity 80. Dividing every intensity by 80 and multiplying by 100 gives 100%, 50%, and 25%. The percentages sum to 175%, which is valid: they compare each signal with the base peak and are not fractions of a total. They are also not percentages of sample composition. Common confusion The base peak need not be an intact molecular ion or the monoisotopic peak; it can be a fragment, an adduct, or background. Its m/z and intensity can change between scans. Separately scaling every scan to 100% removes the original between-scan intensity scale. Keep that distinction when reading an XIC . Use it in a Guide See a changing base peak across three scans Check how intensities were processed

title: 基峰
summary: 谱图中最强的峰，也是相对于基峰计算强度时的分母。
text: 定义 基峰 是指定 质谱图 中强度最高的峰。它描述信号强弱的排序，并不代表某种化学身份。 [1] 相对于基峰的强度按 相对强度（%）= 100 × 峰强度 / 基峰强度 计算。分母是该谱图中最大的峰强度，因此基峰为 100%。分母不是所有峰强度之和。 [2] 简单示例 构造的谱图： m/z 100.000、200.000 和 300.000 处的峰强度分别为 80、40 和 20 任意单位。基峰位于 100.000，强度为 80。将每个强度除以 80，再乘以 100，就得到 100%、50% 和 25%。 这些百分比之和为 175%，这是合理的：它们是各信号与基峰的比值，并非各自占总量的比例，也不是样品组成的百分比。 常见混淆 基峰不一定是完整分子离子峰或单同位素峰，也可能是碎片、加合离子或背景信号。其 m/z 和强度可能随扫描改变。如果每次扫描都单独缩放至 100%，就会丢失原始的跨扫描强度尺度。读取 XIC 时应注意这一区别。 在指南中应用 观察三次扫描中基峰的变化 检查强度的处理方式

title: Retention time
summary: Elapsed time from injection to a chromatographic peak maximum, interpreted within a specified method.
text: Definition Total retention time , t R , is the elapsed time from injection to the relevant chromatographic peak maximum, including hold-up time. [1] A reported “retention time” usually means this total time unless another convention is specified. Record the units and method. A simple example Constructed isocratic example: a peak reaches its maximum at 4.5 min; an appropriate hold-up-time measurement is 1.5 min. Adjusted retention time is 4.5 − 1.5 = 3.0 min. The retention factor is k = (4.5 − 1.5) / 1.5 = 2.0 , a dimensionless quantity. [2] Total time, adjusted time, and retention factor are not interchangeable. Common confusion Retention time is method-dependent, not an immutable molecular property. A matched authentic standard can provide useful identity evidence, but coincident time alone does not distinguish all coeluting species. A time difference can also reflect changed conditions rather than a different compound. In a gradient, mobile-phase composition changes during separation; the simple isocratic retention-factor example should not be read as a constant equilibrium description of the whole run. Also distinguish an observed retention shift from a software alignment that changes the coordinates used for comparison. Use it in a Guide Read retention and hold-up time Understand alignment and feature matching

title: 保留时间
summary: 从进样到色谱峰最大值的时间，需要在指定方法内解释。
text: 定义 总保留时间 t R 是从进样到相应色谱峰最大值所经历的时间，包括死时间。 [1] 除非特别说明其他约定，报告中的“保留时间”通常指总保留时间。应记录单位与方法。 简单示例 构造的等度示例： 某峰在 4.5 min 达到最大值，适当测得的死时间为 1.5 min。调整保留时间为 4.5 − 1.5 = 3.0 min。保留因子为 k = (4.5 − 1.5) / 1.5 = 2.0 ，是无量纲量。 [2] 总保留时间、调整保留时间与保留因子不能互换。 常见混淆 保留时间依赖方法，并非分子不变的固有属性。匹配条件下的真实标准品可以提供有用的身份信息，但时间重合本身不能区分所有共洗脱物种。时间差异也可能反映条件改变，而非化合物不同。 梯度中，流动相组成在分离期间发生变化；不能把简单的等度保留因子示例理解为对整个运行过程的恒定平衡描述。还应区分实际观察到的保留时间移动，与改变比较坐标的软件对齐。 在指南中应用 理解保留时间与死时间 理解对齐与特征匹配

title: Chromatographic peak
summary: An elution-time signal with a baseline, height, width, and area that need not represent one pure component.
text: Definition A chromatographic peak is the detector response associated with material eluting over time. An unresolved peak can contain more than one component. [1] In LC-MS, specify the trace: an extracted-ion peak, a total-ion peak, and a selected product-ion peak can summarize different signals. Peak height is measured relative to the baseline at the apex. Peak area is enclosed between the peak and its baseline. [2] Peak width needs a stated criterion, such as full width at half maximum. A simple example Constructed triangular signals: width 12 s and height 100 units give 0.5 × 12 × 100 = 600 unit·s . Width 6 s and height 200 units give the same area. The taller peak does not have greater integrated signal in this model. Common confusion A chromatographic peak has width along time; a spectral peak has width along m/z. Neither peak alone is a chemical identification. Integration depends on boundaries, baseline, sampling, and interference. A narrow extracted-ion peak can still contain unresolved contributors, and its area requires an appropriate calibration before being interpreted as concentration. The triangles illustrate arithmetic, not realistic peak shape or a mandated integration method. Use it in a Guide Compare shape, area, and separation Connect peak width to acquisition

title: 色谱峰
summary: 具有基线、峰高、峰宽与面积的洗脱时间信号，不一定代表单一纯组分。
text: 定义 色谱峰 是与物质随时间洗脱相关的检测器响应。一个未分离的峰可以包含多个组分。 [1] 在 LC-MS 中，应明确轨迹类型：提取离子峰、总离子峰与选定产物离子峰，可能汇总不同信号。 峰高是在峰顶处相对于基线测得的高度。峰面积是峰与其基线之间围成的面积。 [2] 峰宽需要明确判据，例如半高全宽。 简单示例 构造的三角形信号： 宽 12 s、高 100 单位，面积为 0.5 × 12 × 100 = 600 unit·s 。宽 6 s、高 200 单位，面积相同。在这个模型中，更高的峰并不具有更大的积分信号。 常见混淆 色谱峰的宽度沿时间轴展开，质谱峰的宽度沿 m/z 轴展开。任何一种峰本身都不等于化学鉴定。积分依赖边界、基线、采样和干扰。狭窄的提取离子峰仍可能包含未分开的贡献者；把面积解释为浓度之前，需要合适的校准。三角形用于说明计算，并非真实峰形，也不是规定的积分方法。 在指南中应用 比较峰形、面积与分离 联系峰宽与采集

title: Recovery
summary: Analyte retained through defined preparation steps, separated from matrix-dependent response.
text: Definition Extraction recovery describes how much analyte survives specified extraction and processing steps, relative to the amount presented to those steps. In a matched response experiment, compare analyte added before preparation with analyte added to equivalent blank-matrix extract after preparation. [1] State where the process begins and ends. A simple example Constructed matched responses: pre-preparation addition gives area 600; post-preparation addition gives 800. With equal nominal final amounts, comparable matrix and solvent, and linear response, recovery is 100 × 600 / 800 = 75% . A neat solution gives 1000, so the pre-preparation/neat ratio is 60%; that ratio also includes matrix-dependent response and is not the same recovery estimate. Common confusion Recovery is not ionization efficiency, calibration accuracy, or proof that every relevant compound was retained. It depends on analyte, matrix, concentration, and defined workflow. A spike may not fully represent naturally incorporated analyte, particularly when release or binding differs. ICH M10 does not require 100% recovery in its bioanalytical context, but emphasizes consistency. [2] Lower recovery still requires adequate measurement performance. An internal standard added after extraction cannot experience earlier loss. Preserve raw comparisons and investigate apparent recovery above 100% rather than treating it as creation of analyte. Use it in a Guide Separate preparation loss from matrix effect

title: 回收率
summary: 分析物经过指定前处理步骤后的保留程度，需要与基质相关响应区分。
text: 定义 提取回收率 描述分析物经过指定萃取与处理步骤后保留的量，相对于进入这些步骤时分析物量的比例。在匹配的响应实验中，比较处理前加入分析物的样品，与处理后再向等效空白基质提取液中加入分析物的样品。 [1] 应说明被评价过程的起点与终点。 简单示例 构造的匹配响应： 处理前加标得到面积 600，处理后加标得到 800。在标称最终量相等、基质与溶剂可比、响应线性的条件下，回收率为 100 × 600 / 800 = 75% 。纯溶液响应为 1000，因此处理前加标样品与纯溶液的响应比为 60%；这个比值还包括基质相关响应，并非同一个回收率估计。 常见混淆 回收率不是电离效率、校准准确度，也不能证明所有相关化合物都被保留。它取决于分析物、基质、浓度与指定流程。加标未必完全代表天然存在的分析物，尤其是在释放或结合情况不同的时候。 ICH M10 在其生物分析适用范围内不要求回收率达到 100%，但强调一致性。 [2] 回收率较低时仍需满足测量性能要求。提取后加入的内标无法经历此前的损失。应保留原始比较，并调查超过 100% 的表观回收率，而不是把它解释为产生了额外分析物。 在指南中应用 区分前处理损失与基质效应

title: Matrix effect
summary: A response change caused by accompanying sample constituents, distinct from extraction loss.
text: Definition A matrix effect is a change in analytical response caused by accompanying sample constituents. In LC-MS, this often concerns ion suppression or enhancement. It differs from losing analyte during extraction and from a separate interfering peak being integrated as analyte. Experiments can distinguish matrix-dependent response from preparation recovery. [1] A simple example Constructed matched comparison: an analyte in neat solution gives area 1000; the same nominal final amount added to extracted blank matrix gives 800. The matrix factor is MF = 800 / 1000 = 0.80 , corresponding to 20% lower response. [2] With area 1200, MF would be 1.20, or 20% enhancement. State the formula: “matrix effect percent” is used with different conventions. Common confusion A factor of 0.80 does not say that 20% of the molecules were physically removed. Nor does high extraction recovery establish absence of matrix effects. Match solvent, amount, injection, and matrix comparisons; account for endogenous analyte and interference when applicable. A matrix factor measured in one source of material need not characterize all samples. An internal standard can compensate only to the extent that its response tracks the relevant change. A clean-looking chromatogram and a narrow m/z window do not prove that source-level suppression was absent. Use it in a Guide Calculate recovery and matrix factor separately Connect matrix composition to ion formation

title: 基质效应
summary: 伴随样品组分导致的响应变化，与提取损失不同。
text: 定义 基质效应 是伴随样品组分导致的分析响应变化。在 LC-MS 中，它常指离子抑制或增强。它不同于提取中分析物损失，也不同于把独立干扰峰积分为分析物。实验可以把基质相关响应与前处理回收率区分开。 [1] 简单示例 构造的匹配比较： 纯溶液中的分析物产生面积 1000；向提取后的空白基质加入相同标称最终量，得到 800。基质因子为 MF = 800 / 1000 = 0.80 ，对应响应降低 20%。 [2] 如果面积为 1200，则 MF = 1.20，即增强 20%。应写明公式，因为“基质效应百分比”存在不同表述约定。 常见混淆 0.80 的因子并不表示有 20% 的分子被物理移除。高提取回收率也不能证明没有基质效应。应匹配溶剂、量、进样及基质比较，并在适用时考虑内源性分析物与干扰。 在一种来源材料中测得的基质因子，未必能代表所有样品。内标只有在其响应能够追踪相关变化的程度上，才能提供补偿。看起来干净的色谱图和狭窄的 m/z 窗口，都不能证明离子源中的抑制不存在。 在指南中应用 分别计算回收率与基质因子 联系基质组成与离子形成

title: Carryover
summary: Previously introduced material contributes to a later measurement; impact depends on the next result.
text: Definition Carryover occurs when previously introduced sample material contributes to a later measurement. Residue may remain in the injection path or chromatographic system and appear in subsequent samples or blanks. [1] It is a history-dependent contamination problem, not a synonym for every background signal. A simple example Constructed area comparison: a high sample gives 1,000,000 units and the following blank gives 1000. The blank/high ratio is 100 × 1000 / 1000000 = 0.10% . If a low-level reference gives 2000, that blank is 50% of the low-level response. A small percentage of a large signal can materially affect a small subsequent result. Common confusion A peak in one blank does not establish carryover or locate its source. Compare relevant pre- and post-challenge blanks, composition, and sequence history. A decaying series supports a residual contribution but does not uniquely identify a component. Report the numerator, denominator, any background correction, and method-specific acceptance rule. ICH M10 uses low-level analyte and internal-standard response comparisons for its chromatographic bioanalytical context. [2] Do not transplant those criteria to every application. A clean later blank does not retroactively validate an earlier affected sample, and randomization does not remove residual material. Use it in a Guide Interpret sequence-dependent signals

title: 进样残留
summary: 先前引入的物质对后续测量产生贡献，其影响取决于后续结果的水平。
text: 定义 进样残留 指先前引入的样品物质对后续测量产生贡献。残留物可能留在进样流路或色谱系统中，并出现在之后的样品或空白里。 [1] 它是一种依赖历史的污染问题，不是所有背景信号的同义词。 简单示例 构造的峰面积比较： 高水平样品产生 1,000,000 单位，随后空白产生 1000。空白/高水平样品比为 100 × 1000 / 1000000 = 0.10% 。如果低水平参比产生 2000，该空白就是低水平响应的 50%。大信号中很小的百分比，可能明显影响后续的小信号结果。 常见混淆 一个空白中的峰，不能确定存在进样残留，也不能定位来源。应比较相关高负荷进样前后的空白、组成与序列历史。逐渐下降的序列支持残留贡献的解释，但不能唯一确定某个部件。 应报告分子、分母、任何背景校正以及方法特定的验收规则。ICH M10 在其色谱生物分析适用范围内，使用低水平分析物与内标响应进行比较。 [2] 不要把这些判据移植到所有应用。之后一个干净的空白不能追溯性地验证此前受影响的样品，随机化也不会去除残留物。 在指南中应用 解释与序列相关的信号

title: Blank
summary: A control whose contents, treatment, and sequence position define the background question it can answer.
text: Definition A blank is an analytical control used to investigate signal contributed by specified parts of a workflow when the intended sample or target addition is absent. Its meaning comes from its contents and treatment. A minimally processed solvent blank and a process blank carried through preparation answer different questions. [1] A simple example Constructed comparison: an injection blank has no relevant detected peak, but a procedural blank has one after passing through extraction and transfer. This directs attention toward the additional steps or materials; it does not prove which reagent or surface caused the peak. The controls must be otherwise comparable. Common confusion Blank matrix is intended to lack the target while retaining representative matrix constituents; it is not automatically equivalent to pure solvent. Endogenous targets may prevent a genuinely target-free matrix. A blank containing internal standard should be distinguished from one without it. A blank after a high injection probes a different sequence history from one before it. Neither a single clean blank nor absence above a reporting threshold proves absolute absence. Likewise, a feature seen in a blank may also genuinely occur in samples. Record blank type, preparation, sequence position, processing, and the comparison used; do not hide these choices behind one “blank-corrected” label. Use it in a Guide Choose an informative blank Track preparation and introduced signal

title: 空白
summary: 一种对照，其内容物、处理方式与序列位置决定它能回答哪种背景问题。
text: 定义 空白 是一种分析对照，在没有预期样品或没有加入目标物时，用于调查流程中指定部分贡献的信号。其含义来自内容物与处理方式。只经过最少处理的溶剂空白，与经历前处理的过程空白，回答不同问题。 [1] 简单示例 构造比较： 进样空白中没有检测到相关峰，但经历提取与转移后的程序空白中出现了峰。这把调查重点引向新增步骤或材料，却不能证明是哪一种试剂或表面造成该峰。其他方面的对照条件应可比。 常见混淆 空白基质预期不含目标物，同时保留有代表性的基质组分；它不自动等同于纯溶剂。目标物为内源性成分时，可能无法获得真正不含目标物的基质。含内标空白应与不含内标空白区分。 高水平进样之后的空白，与之前的空白检验的是不同序列历史。单个干净空白，或未超过报告阈值，都不能证明绝对不存在相关物质。同样，空白中出现的特征也可能真实存在于样品中。应记录空白类型、前处理、序列位置、数据处理及采用的比较，不要用一个“已做空白校正”的标签掩盖这些选择。 在指南中应用 选择有信息价值的空白 追踪前处理与引入的信号

title: Calibration curve
summary: A response–quantity relationship used to calculate results within an established range.
text: Definition A calibration curve expresses the relationship between an instrument indication and a corresponding measured quantity value. In quantitative MS, it commonly relates analyte concentration to peak area or an analyte/internal-standard response ratio. VIM cautions that the curve alone does not include measurement uncertainty. [1] State the axes and units: a concentration-calibration curve is different from a curve that assigns m/z . Constructed example Suppose the response ratio obeys y = 0.020 + 0.050c , with c in ng/mL and a supported interval of 1–10 ng/mL. A ratio of 0.320 gives c = (0.320 − 0.020) / 0.050 = 6.0 ng/mL . The slope has units mL/ng. This inverse calculation assumes the model applies to the unknown; the arithmetic does not validate that assumption. What the curve does not establish A high R 2 is insufficient evidence of an adequate model. Inspect residual patterns and low-level performance rather than judging only the visual straightness of the plotted points. [2] Standards used to fit a curve do not replace independent quality checks. Do not silently extrapolate beyond the established range, force a zero intercept, or transfer one compound's response factor to another. For dilution and lower-range decisions, continue with the quantitative calibration Guide .

title: 校准曲线
summary: 用于在已建立范围内计算结果的响应与量值关系。
text: 定义 校准曲线表达仪器示值与相应测得量值之间的关系。在定量质谱中，通常将分析物浓度与峰面积或分析物/内标响应比联系起来。VIM 提醒，曲线本身并不包含测量不确定度。 [1] 应写明坐标轴及单位：浓度校准曲线不同于用于赋予 m/z 的曲线。 构造示例 假设响应比满足 y = 0.020 + 0.050c ，c 的单位为 ng/mL，支持的区间为 1–10 ng/mL。响应比为 0.320 时， c = (0.320 − 0.020) / 0.050 = 6.0 ng/mL 。斜率单位为 mL/ng。反算假设模型适用于未知样品；计算本身不能验证这一假设。 曲线不能确立什么 很高的 R 2 不足以证明模型适当。应检查残差模式及低浓度表现，而不只是判断图中各点是否看起来接近直线。 [2] 用于拟合曲线的标准不能替代独立质量检查。不能默默超出已建立的范围外推、强制零截距，或把一种化合物的响应因子转用于另一种。有关稀释及低端范围的判断，参见 定量校准指南 。

title: Internal standard
summary: An added reference substance whose response can track specified shared measurement variation.
text: Definition An internal standard is a reference substance added to standards, quality controls, and unknown samples so that its measured response can help quantify an analyte. Its identity, amount, addition stage, and suitability must be specified. In regulated drug bioanalysis, ICH M10 recommends stable-isotope-labelled analyte standards for MS when possible, with checks for purity, interference, and isotope exchange. [1] A labelled compound is not automatically suitable merely because its mass differs. Constructed example Two samples receive the same amount of internal standard. Analyte/standard areas are 30,000/15,000 and 18,000/9,000, so both response ratios equal 2. In a stipulated model where the second measurement has a shared response multiplier of 0.6, division cancels that multiplier. It does not prove that the samples contain 2 ng/mL or any other concentration: a calibration relationship is still needed. Shared variation is the key assumption A disturbance affecting only the analyte will not cancel in the ratio. An internal standard added late cannot represent earlier changes it never experienced. Monitor its raw response as well as the ratio; an unusual denominator can make a ratio unstable or misleading. One standard should not be assumed to track every analyte in an untargeted experiment. See quantitative calibration for the distinction between a response ratio and a reported quantity.

title: 内标
summary: 加入的参照物质，其响应可跟踪规定的共同测量变异。
text: 定义 内标是加入标准、质量控制样品及未知样品的参照物质，通过其测得响应帮助定量分析物。应说明身份、加入量、加入阶段及适用性。在受监管的药物生物分析中，ICH M10 建议质谱检测尽可能采用分析物的稳定同位素标记内标，并检查纯度、干扰及同位素交换。 [1] 标记化合物不会仅因质量不同就自动适用。 构造示例 两个样品加入相同量的内标。分析物/内标峰面积分别为 30,000/15,000 和 18,000/9,000，响应比均为 2。若规定第二次测量具有共同的 0.6 响应乘数，除法会抵消这个乘数。但这并不能证明样品浓度是 2 ng/mL 或其他浓度；仍然需要 校准关系 。 共同变异是关键假设 只影响分析物的扰动不会在比值中抵消。晚加入的内标不能代表其未经历的早期变化。除了比值，还应监测内标原始响应；异常分母可能使比值不稳定或具有误导性。不能假定一个内标可以跟踪非靶向实验中的所有分析物。响应比与报告量值的区别，参见 定量校准指南 。

title: Limit of detection
summary: Detection capability defined by a procedure, decision rule, and error probabilities.
text: Definition The limit of detection (LOD, also DL) characterizes detection under a specified measurement procedure and decision rule. VIM defines it with both the probability of falsely declaring presence and the probability of missing a component. [1] It is not a universal instrument constant, a guarantee that every sample above a number is detected, or a measure of concentration precision. Constructed estimate One approach in ICH Q2(R2) for a linear response uses DL = 3.3σ/S , where σ is an appropriate response standard deviation and S is the calibration slope. [2] With a dimensionless response ratio, σ = 0.003 and S = 0.050 mL/ng give DL = 0.198 ng/mL . This is an illustrative estimate for the stated model, not a validated performance claim or a universal choice of statistical rule. A nondetection does not establish absence Specify the analyte, sample type, procedure, decision criterion, and how the limit was estimated and checked. Background behavior and interference matter; a threshold from one setting need not transfer to another. A result below the detection capability is not automatically zero. Reliable detection also does not establish reliable quantification: see the limit of quantification . Preserve the relevant flags when recording unavailable results .

title: 检出限
summary: 由程序、判定规则及错误概率界定的检出能力。
text: 定义 检出限（LOD，也写作 DL）描述规定测量程序及判定规则下的检出能力。VIM 的定义同时考虑错误宣称存在与漏检组分的概率。 [1] 它不是通用仪器常数，不保证高于某数值的每份样品都被检出，也不是浓度精密度的度量。 构造的估计 ICH Q2(R2) 针对线性响应描述的一种方法使用 DL = 3.3σ/S ，其中 σ 为适当的响应标准差，S 为校准斜率。 [2] 对于无量纲响应比， σ = 0.003 、 S = 0.050 mL/ng ，得到 DL = 0.198 ng/mL 。这是给定模型下的教学估计，不是已验证的性能声明，也不是统计判定规则的通用选择。 未检出不能证明不存在 应说明分析物、样品类型、程序、判定标准，以及如何估计和检验限值。背景行为及干扰很重要，一个条件下的阈值未必适用于另一个条件。低于检出能力的结果并不自动等于零。可靠检出也不能确立可靠定量，参见 定量限 。记录 不可用结果 时应保留相关标记。

title: Limit of quantification
summary: The lower level at which specified quantitative performance is supported.
text: Definition The limit of quantification (LOQ, also QL) is the lower level at which an analytical procedure can provide quantitative results meeting specified performance requirements. The requirements and their evaluation must be stated. A detectable peak may still be too imprecise, biased, or affected by interference for the intended quantitative use. ICH Q2(R2) distinguishes estimating a lower limit from validating its performance. [1] Constructed estimate and reporting scale For one linear-response approach, QL = 10σ/S . With σ = 0.003 response-ratio units and S = 0.050 mL/ng , the estimate is 0.600 ng/mL . That calculation alone does not establish the method's usable lower limit. Separately, suppose a validated method has an LOQ of 1.0 ng/mL in the measured solution. A fivefold dilution corresponds to 5 × 1.0 = 5.0 ng/mL on the original-sample scale, assuming the dilution procedure is valid. Reporting the undiluted limit as 1.0 ng/mL would misstate what that measurement supports. Keep the scope with the limit Document the analyte, sample type, units, procedure, dilution, and applicable performance criteria. Do not equate a signal-to-noise threshold with full quantitative validation. A below-LOQ result is not automatically zero or eligible for arbitrary numeric replacement. Distinguish this limit from the LOD and from the upper end of the calibration range .

title: 定量限
summary: 能够支持规定定量性能的低端水平。
text: 定义 定量限（LOQ，也写作 QL）是分析程序能够给出满足规定性能要求的定量结果的低端水平。应明确这些要求及评估方式。可检出的峰仍可能因精密度不足、偏倚或干扰而不适合预期定量用途。ICH Q2(R2) 区分对低端限值的估计与对其性能的验证。 [1] 构造估计与报告尺度 一种线性响应方法使用 QL = 10σ/S 。若 σ = 0.003 （响应比单位）， S = 0.050 mL/ng ，估计值为 0.600 ng/mL 。仅凭这项计算不能确立方法可用的低端限值。 另行假设，某已验证方法在待测溶液中的 LOQ 为 1.0 ng/mL。若稀释程序有效，五倍稀释后对应原样品尺度的限值为 5 × 1.0 = 5.0 ng/mL 。将原样品限值报告为 1.0 ng/mL，会错误表述这次测量所支持的能力。 限值应始终附带适用范围 应记录分析物、样品类型、单位、程序、稀释及适用性能标准。不要将信噪比阈值等同于完整定量验证。低于 LOQ 的结果不自动等于零，也不能任意替换为某个数值。应区分 LOQ、 LOD 以及 校准范围 的高端。

title: Biological replicate
summary: Replication at a stated biological level, whose independence follows the sampling and intervention design.
text: Definition A biological replicate represents repeated sampling or generation at the biological level relevant to a question. The label alone does not establish statistical independence. Specify the biological entity, sampling process, treatment assignment, and any shared groups. Lazic and colleagues distinguish biological, experimental, and observational units precisely because these levels can differ. [1] The number of tubes or raw files cannot settle the replicate count. Constructed hierarchy Eight independently sampled donors each supply one sample. Each sample has two separately prepared aliquots, each injected three times. The resulting 8 × 2 × 3 = 48 injections describe eight donors and 16 preparations. For a donor-level comparison, those 48 injections are not 48 independent biological replicates. If intervention was assigned to a higher-level group, even the donor count may not equal the number of experimental units. Independence follows the design Technical repeats help assess lower-level variability; repeated time points characterize trajectories. Neither automatically adds independent biological units. Conversely, an independently treated aliquot can be an experimental unit for an aliquot-level question without becoming a new donor. Preserve the hierarchy and use analysis suited to it. [2] Report counts at each level and explain which units support the inference; see experimental design and replication .

title: 生物学重复
summary: 在明确生物学层级上的重复，其独立性由抽样及干预设计决定。
text: 定义 生物学重复是在与问题相关的生物学层级上重复抽样或生成的单位。仅凭这个标签不能确立统计独立性。应说明生物学实体、抽样过程、处理分配及任何共享分组。Lazic 等区分生物学、实验及观测单位，正是因为这些层级可能不同。 [1] 试管数或原始文件数不能决定重复数。 构造的层级 八名独立抽样的供者各提供一份样品。每份样品有两个分别制备的分装，每份制备物进样三次。所得 8 × 2 × 3 = 48 次进样 描述的是八名供者和 16 份制备物。对于供者层面的比较，这 48 次进样并不是 48 个独立生物学重复。若干预被分配给更高层级的组，连供者数也未必等于实验单位数。 独立性由设计决定 技术重复帮助评估低层级变异，重复时间点刻画轨迹；二者都不会自动增加独立生物学单位。反过来，对于分装层面的问题，独立接受处理的分装可以是实验单位，但不会变成新供者。应保留层级，并使用适合的分析。 [2] 报告各层级的数量，解释哪些单位支持推断；参见 实验设计与重复 。

title: Batch effect
summary: Systematic technical variation associated with processing groups or acquisition order.
text: Definition A batch effect is systematic variation associated with groups of samples processed or measured under differing technical conditions. It may appear as a shift between batches, a trend within a run, or feature-specific changes. A batch label can mark a processing day, instrument sequence, reagent lot, or another relevant grouping; record which meaning applies. In untargeted MS, correction performance depends on the data, design, and control information. [1] Constructed ambiguity Suppose every control sample is measured in batch A and every treated sample in batch B. The observed treated/control ratio is 1.5. One explanation is a biological multiplier of 1.5 with no batch change. Another is no biological change and a batch multiplier of 1.5. Both predict the same observations in this simple multiplicative model. The group means alone cannot distinguish them. Correction needs identifying information Balance conditions across feasible batches, retain run-order metadata, and use appropriate reference samples. Blocking and randomization help prevent technical factors from aligning with condition. [2] A correction algorithm does not create information missing from a completely confounded design, and identical post-correction distributions do not prove biology was preserved. Investigate the suspected mechanism and examine independent QC evidence; see QC, batch effects, and normalization .

title: 批次效应
summary: 与处理分组或采集顺序相关的系统性技术变异。
text: 定义 批次效应是与不同技术条件下处理或测量的样品分组相关的系统性变异。它可表现为批次间偏移、运行内趋势，或特征特异的变化。批次标签可以表示处理日、仪器序列、试剂批号或其他相关分组，应记录具体含义。在非靶向质谱中，校正表现取决于数据、设计及质控信息。 [1] 构造的歧义 假设全部对照样品在 A 批测量，全部处理样品在 B 批测量，观测到处理/对照比为 1.5。一种解释是生物学乘数为 1.5，批次没有变化；另一种解释是生物学没有变化，而批次乘数为 1.5。在这个简单乘性模型中，两种解释预测完全相同的观测。仅凭组均值无法区分。 校正需要可识别信息 在可行的批次间平衡条件，保留运行顺序元数据，并使用适当参照样品。区组与随机化有助于避免技术因素与条件对齐。 [2] 校正算法不能创造完全混杂设计中缺少的信息，校正后分布相同也不能证明生物学信息被保留。应研究可疑机制，并检查独立质控证据；参见 质控、批次效应与归一化 。

title: Peptide-spectrum match
summary: A proposed spectrum-to-peptide association, distinct from a peptide count or a guaranteed identification.
text: Definition A peptide-spectrum match (PSM) is a proposed association between an experimental MS/MS spectrum and a peptide interpretation, including relevant sequence, modifications, and charge. A search score measures agreement under a particular method and candidate set. A top-ranked PSM is not automatically an accepted identification or a calibrated probability. [1] Count the reporting unit Constructed example: five spectra assigned to the same peptide produce five PSMs but only one distinct unmodified peptide sequence. If two assignments propose an oxidized form, the sequence count can remain one while the modified-form count becomes two. Report which definition was used rather than treating these counts as interchangeable. Common confusion A spectrum may contain coisolated species, and an assignment need not explain every peak. A PSM can also be wrong even when it has the highest score among tested candidates. Statistical post-processing can estimate assignment confidence, but that confidence is model-dependent. [2] PSM-level error control does not automatically provide peptide-, protein-, or site-localization error control. Retain the source spectrum identifier, candidate interpretation, search settings, score, and filtering result. Use it in a Guide Compare PSM and peptide error fractions

title: 肽段–谱图匹配
summary: 提出的谱图与肽段对应关系，不等于肽段计数或确定无误的鉴定。
text: 定义 肽段–谱图匹配 （PSM）是实验 MS/MS 谱图与某个肽段解释之间提出的对应关系，包括相关序列、修饰和电荷。检索分数衡量特定方法和候选集合下的一致性。最高排名的 PSM 并不自动等于通过筛选的鉴定或经过校准的概率。 [1] 明确计数单位 构造的例子： 五张谱图指认到同一肽段，会产生五条 PSM，却只有一个不同的未修饰肽段序列。如果其中两条指认提出氧化形式，序列数可以仍为一，而修饰形式数变为二。应报告所用定义，不要把这些计数当作可互换。 常见混淆 一张谱图可能包含共同隔离的物种，某个指认也未必解释每个峰。即使在测试的候选中得分最高，PSM 仍可能错误。统计后处理可以估计指认置信度，但这种置信度依赖模型。 [2] PSM 层面的错误控制不会自动带来肽段、蛋白质或位点定位层面的错误控制。应保留源谱图标识、候选解释、检索设置、分数和筛选结果。 在指南中使用 比较 PSM 和肽段错误比例

title: Protein inference
summary: Evaluate parent-protein evidence while retaining shared-peptide ambiguity and protein-group membership.
text: Definition Protein inference evaluates which proteins or protein groups are supported by identified peptides, using their sequence mappings, confidence, and explicit inference rules. It is needed because a peptide can occur in several database proteins. ProteinProphet is a foundational probabilistic implementation; its existence does not make every displayed accession independently identified. [1] Shared evidence has multiple explanations Constructed example: A contains p and q; B contains p and r. Observing only p is consistent with A, B, or both. Ten additional spectra of p do not distinguish its parent. A confidently observed q unique to A supports A, but failure to observe r does not prove B absent. Common confusion A parsimonious protein list is a compact explanation of evidence, not proof that all omitted compatible proteins are absent. A protein group may be displayed with a representative accession selected by reporting rules. Preserve alternative members and the peptides supporting each one. Standardized mzIdentML reporting distinguishes leading proteins, group representatives, and shared-evidence relationships. [2] Uniqueness is relative to the database and chosen level, such as accession or gene. Protein-level error assessment and shared-peptide quantification require their own stated procedures. Use it in a Guide Work through an ambiguous peptide mapping

title: 蛋白质推断
summary: 评估母体蛋白质证据，同时保留共享肽段歧义和蛋白质分组成员。
text: 定义 蛋白质推断 根据已鉴定肽段的序列映射、置信度和明确的推断规则，评估哪些蛋白质或蛋白质分组得到支持。因为一个肽段可能出现在多个数据库蛋白质中，所以需要这一步。ProteinProphet 是一种基础性的概率实现；使用它并不意味着每个显示的登录号都被独立鉴定。 [1] 共享证据有多种解释 构造的例子： A 含 p 和 q；B 含 p 和 r。只观察到 p 与 A、B 或两者都有均相容。再增加十张 p 的谱图也不能区分母体。可信观察到对 A 唯一的 q 可以支持 A，但未观察到 r 并不能证明 B 不存在。 常见混淆 简约蛋白质列表是对证据的紧凑解释，不是所有被省略的兼容蛋白质都不存在的证明。蛋白质分组可能用报告规则选出的代表登录号显示。应保留其他可能成员及支持每个成员的肽段。标准化的 mzIdentML 报告区分领先蛋白、分组代表和共享证据关系。 [2] 唯一性相对于数据库及所选层级而言，例如登录号或基因。蛋白质层面的错误评估与共享肽段定量也需要各自说明程序。 在指南中使用 分析含歧义的肽段映射

title: Proteotypic peptide
summary: A reliably observable peptide in a defined workflow; check sequence specificity separately.
text: Definition A proteotypic peptide is a peptide repeatedly and reliably observed for a protein in a defined proteomic workflow. Mallick and colleagues studied this preferential observability across platforms. The term is also used in assay contexts with an added requirement of protein specificity, so state the operational definition rather than assuming everyone means the same thing. [1] Detectability and uniqueness are different axes Constructed example: peptide p is detected in nine of ten reference-digest injections but maps to two homologous proteins. Peptide q maps only to one protein but is detected in two injections. In this experiment, p is more consistently observable; q provides more specific sequence evidence. Neither fact alone establishes a validated quantitative assay. Common confusion “Unique peptide” describes sequence mapping relative to a database and reporting level. “Proteotypic” commonly describes empirical observability. Check both. A change in digestion, labeling, chromatography, matrix, or acquisition can alter performance; observations in a large proteome study demonstrate that chemical labels can change peptide detectability. [2] For quantitative use, also assess interference, stability, response range, and whether the peptide represents the protein form of interest. A frequently detected shared peptide cannot distinguish its possible parent proteins. Use it in a Guide Choose peptide evidence for a protein quantity

title: 蛋白质代表性肽段
summary: 在明确流程中能可靠观察的肽段；序列特异性仍须单独检验。
text: 定义 蛋白质代表性肽段 （proteotypic peptide）是在明确的蛋白质组学流程中，能够反复、可靠地观察到的某个蛋白质的肽段。Mallick 等研究了不同平台上的这种优先可观测性。在检测方法语境中，该词有时还附带蛋白质特异性要求，因此应说明操作性定义，而不要假定所有人所指相同。 [1] 可检测性和唯一性是两个维度 构造的例子： 肽段 p 在十次参考酶解物进样中被检出九次，却映射到两个同源蛋白。肽段 q 只映射到一个蛋白质，但仅在两次进样中检出。在本实验中，p 更容易被稳定观察，q 则提供更特异的序列证据。任何一个事实都不足以单独建立经过验证的定量检测方法。 常见混淆 “唯一肽段”描述相对于数据库和报告层级的序列映射；“proteotypic”通常描述经验上的可观测性。两者都应检查。酶解、标记、色谱、基质或采集变化都可能改变性能；大型蛋白质组研究的观察表明，化学标记可以改变肽段可检测性。 [2] 用于定量时，还应评估干扰、稳定性、响应范围，以及该肽段是否代表目标蛋白质形式。经常检出的共享肽段不能区分其可能的母体蛋白质。 在指南中使用 为蛋白质量选择肽段证据

title: Post-translational modification
summary: A protein change after translation, distinguished from preparation chemistry, mass-shift hypotheses, and site assignments.
text: Definition A post-translational modification (PTM) is a chemical change to a protein after translation. Examples include phosphorylation, acetylation, and glycosylation. In an MS analysis, distinguish a biological PTM from a preparation-induced chemical change or artifact. Sequence-description standards such as ProForma accommodate these different origins rather than treating every annotated mass shift as biological. [1] A mass shift is a starting hypothesis Unimod records phosphorylation as a monoisotopic increment of 79.966331 Da . Under unchanged charge +2 and otherwise identical ion composition, this produces an m/z shift of approximately 39.983166 . This supports a modification hypothesis; precursor agreement alone does not locate it or establish its biological origin. [2] Common confusion Searching a variable modification does not prove that modification occurred. A confident modified-peptide identification can still have an uncertain site. Different placements can share the same precursor mass, so report candidate positions and localization confidence separately from peptide identity. A larger modified-peptide signal also does not by itself establish higher site occupancy. Total protein abundance, enrichment, recovery, and response can change the signal. Preserve the distinction among mass change, chemical assignment, position, and quantitative interpretation. Use it in a Guide Follow modification evidence through localization and quantification

title: 翻译后修饰
summary: 翻译后发生的蛋白质变化，应与制备化学、质量偏移假设和位点指认区分。
text: 定义 翻译后修饰 （PTM）是在翻译之后发生的蛋白质化学变化，例如磷酸化、乙酰化和糖基化。在质谱分析中，应区分生物学 PTM 与制备引入的化学变化或伪影。ProForma 等序列描述标准容纳这些不同来源，而不是把每个已标注的质量偏移都当成生物学变化。 [1] 质量偏移是起始假设 Unimod 将磷酸化记为 79.966331 Da 的单同位素质量增量。在电荷保持 +2 且离子组成的其他部分相同的条件下，它产生约 39.983166 的 m/z 偏移。这支持修饰假设；仅有前体吻合不能定位修饰，也不能确定其生物学来源。 [2] 常见混淆 在检索中允许某种可变修饰，不代表该修饰确实发生。可信的修饰肽鉴定仍可能具有不确定的位点。不同位置可以拥有相同前体质量，因此应将候选位置和定位置信度与肽段身份分开报告。 更大的修饰肽信号本身也不能确定更高的位点占有率。总蛋白丰度、富集、回收和响应都可能改变信号。应保留质量变化、化学指认、位置与定量解释之间的区别。 在指南中使用 沿修饰证据理解定位和定量

title: Site localization
summary: Determine a modification position using evidence that distinguishes competing placements.
text: Definition Site localization determines where a modification is placed within an identified peptide or protein sequence. Alternative positions can have identical precursor masses. Localization therefore evaluates evidence that distinguishes those placements, often site-determining fragment ions, rather than relying only on overall peptide-spectrum agreement. Ascore provides an early probability-based approach to this problem. [1] Ask whether a fragment separates the candidates Constructed example: in ASSTK with one phosphate allowed at S2 or S3, a modification-retaining b2 fragment contains only S2.
