Its predicted mass differs between the two placements. A b3 fragment contains both sites and has the same mass under either placement. This simplified example assumes b/y backbone fragmentation without modification loss; it does not guarantee detectable fragments. Common confusion Correct peptide identification does not guarantee correct localization. Localization scores, calibrated site probabilities, and estimated false localization rates are different quantities. PTMProphet models positional confidence and shows how it can support localization-error estimation. State the method, allowed positions, threshold, and reporting unit. [2] Retain ambiguous positions when evidence cannot distinguish them. Even a confidently localized peptide position can map to multiple protein accessions, so protein assignment and residue numbering remain separate checks. Use it in a Guide Compare site-determining fragments

title: 位点定位
summary: 利用能够区分竞争位置的证据，确定修饰位点。
text: 定义 位点定位 确定某个修饰位于已鉴定肽段或蛋白质序列中的什么位置。不同位置可能具有相同前体质量。因此，定位评估能够区分这些位置的证据，常见的是决定位置的碎片离子，而不是仅依赖肽段与谱图的整体一致性。Ascore 是解决该问题的早期概率方法。 [1] 问碎片是否能区分候选 构造的例子： 在 ASSTK 中，仅允许一个磷酸基位于 S2 或 S3。保留修饰的 b2 碎片只包含 S2，因此两种位置下的预测质量不同。b3 包含两个位点，在任一种位置下质量都相同。这个简化例子假设产生 b/y 骨架碎片且修饰不丢失，并不保证碎片能够被检测。 常见混淆 肽段鉴定正确不保证定位正确。定位分数、经过校准的位点概率与估计错误定位率是不同量。PTMProphet 对位置置信度建模，并展示其如何支持定位错误估计。应说明方法、允许位置、阈值和报告单位。 [2] 当证据不能区分位置时，应保留歧义。即使肽段位置已被可信定位，它仍可能映射到多个蛋白质登录号，因此蛋白质指认与残基编号仍需另外检查。 在指南中使用 比较决定位置的碎片

title: Sequence coverage
summary: The fraction of reference residue positions covered by accepted peptide mappings, counting overlaps once.
text: Definition Sequence coverage commonly reports the percentage of residue positions in a specified reference protein covered by accepted mapped peptides. Compute the union of covered positions, divide by the reference length, and multiply by 100. State the reference sequence, peptide acceptance criteria, and treatment of shared or ambiguous mappings. Identification formats preserve peptide-to-protein evidence needed to inspect these choices. [1] Count overlapping positions once Constructed example: a 100-residue reference has accepted peptides covering positions 1–10 and 6–15, with inclusive coordinates. Their union covers positions 1–15, so coverage is 15 / 100 × 100 = 15% . Adding the two peptide lengths would incorrectly give 20%. Repeating either PSM does not increase covered positions. Common confusion Coverage is not the fraction of protein molecules detected, the protein's abundance, or an identification probability. High coverage in shared regions may still fail to distinguish homologs or isoforms. Protein-group reporting exists to retain that kind of ambiguity. [2] A covered residue is not automatically a localized modification site. Bottom-up coverage also cannot alone establish which distant modifications coexist on one intact protein. Compare coverage only when reference sequences and counting rules are compatible. Use it in a Guide Relate coverage to protein evidence

title: 序列覆盖率
summary: 通过筛选的肽段映射所覆盖的参考残基位置比例，重叠位置仅计一次。
text: 定义 序列覆盖率 通常表示：某条指定参考蛋白质序列中，被通过筛选并完成映射的肽段所覆盖的残基位置百分比。计算被覆盖位置的并集，除以参考序列长度，再乘以 100。应写明参考序列、肽段接受标准及共享或含歧义映射的处理方式。鉴定格式保留了检查这些选择所需的肽段–蛋白质证据。 [1] 重叠位置只计一次 构造的例子： 某参考序列有 100 个残基，通过筛选的肽段分别覆盖位置 1–10 和 6–15，坐标包含两端。其并集覆盖位置 1–15，因此覆盖率为 15 / 100 × 100 = 15% 。将两个肽段长度直接相加会错误地得到 20%。重复任一 PSM 都不会增加被覆盖位置。 常见混淆 覆盖率不是检出的蛋白质分子比例、蛋白质丰度或鉴定概率。共有区域的高覆盖率仍可能无法区分同源蛋白或异构体。蛋白质分组报告正是为了保留这类歧义。 [2] 被覆盖的残基不自动等于已定位的修饰位点。自下而上的覆盖率本身也不能确定相距较远的修饰是否共存于同一个完整蛋白质上。只有参考序列与计数规则兼容时，才适合比较覆盖率。 在指南中使用 将覆盖率与蛋白质证据联系起来

title: Molecular formula
summary: Element counts constrain candidates without specifying connectivity or stereochemistry.
text: Definition A molecular formula specifies the elemental composition of a discrete molecule: which elements occur and how many atoms of each are present. It does not specify their connectivity or stereochemistry. C 6 H 12 O 6 is a molecular formula; CH 2 O gives its simplest whole-number elemental ratio, an empirical formula. [1] A simple example For the C 6 H 12 O 6 teaching hypothesis in the linked Guide, the neutral monoisotopic mass is approximately 180.063388 Da. A singly protonated ion has calculated m/z 181.070665. Those numbers assume specified isotopes and protonation; a sodium adduct requires a different calculation. Formula software must distinguish neutral composition from the composition and charge of the measured ion. Common confusion A unique formula within a restricted search is not a unique structure. Isomers can share the same formula, and an inappropriate element list or adduct assignment may exclude the correct formula entirely. Accurate mass, isotope evidence, and chemical constraints narrow candidate formulas; heuristic filtering does not turn a formula into an identification. [2] Report the search assumptions and unresolved candidates rather than silently converting the first formula hit into a compound name. Use it in a Guide Build and test a formula hypothesis Review mass, charge, and isotopes

title: 分子式
summary: 元素数目约束候选物，但不指定连接关系或立体化学。
text: 定义 分子式 指定一个独立分子的元素组成：包含哪些元素，以及各有多少个原子。它不指定原子连接关系或立体化学。C 6 H 12 O 6 是分子式；CH 2 O 给出其最简整数元素比例，即实验式。 [1] 简单示例 对于所链接指南中的 C 6 H 12 O 6 教学假设，中性单同位素质量约为 180.063388 Da，单质子化离子的理论 m/z 为 181.070665。这些数值假定了指定同位素和质子化形式；钠加合离子需要不同计算。分子式软件必须区分中性组成与被测离子的组成和电荷。 常见混淆 在受限搜索中唯一的分子式，不等于唯一结构。 异构体 可以共享分子式，而不恰当的元素列表或加合形式归属可能完全排除正确分子式。准确质量、同位素证据和化学约束可以缩小候选范围；启发式筛选不会把分子式变成身份鉴定。 [2] 应报告检索假设与未解决的候选物，而不是悄悄把第一条分子式命中转换成化合物名称。 在指南中应用 建立并检验分子式假设 复习质量、电荷和同位素

title: Isomer
summary: The same molecular formula can describe different structures; isobars are a different distinction.
text: Definition Isomers have the same molecular formula but different atom connectivity or stereochemical arrangements. Constitutional isomers differ in connectivity; stereoisomers retain connectivity but differ in spatial arrangement. [1] Equal elemental composition means equal calculated exact mass for corresponding isotope compositions, not necessarily equal fragmentation or separation behavior. A simple example Consider hypothetical candidates A and B with the same neutral formula and isotope composition. Both form [M+H] + . Making the mass measurement more accurate cannot distinguish their identical theoretical m/z values. A chromatographic method or diagnostic fragmentation might distinguish them, but that discrimination must be demonstrated rather than assumed from the technique's name. Common confusion In the IUPAC mass-spectrometry definition, isobars have the same nominal mass but different exact masses. [2] They need not have the same molecular formula and are not synonymous with isomers. Sufficient mass resolving power can separate suitable isobaric ions; it cannot separate same-isotope, same-charge isomers on exact mass alone. Some informal uses of “isobaric” are broader, so state the intended meaning. An isotopologue differs in isotope composition. It should not be confused with the structural alternatives under discussion here. Record both ion form and the unresolved kind of isomerism. Use it in a Guide Design a discriminating experiment Separate lipid structural claims

title: 异构体
summary: 相同分子式可以对应不同结构；同量异位物种涉及另一种区别。
text: 定义 异构体 具有相同分子式，但原子连接关系或立体化学排列不同。构造异构体的连接关系不同；立体异构体保留相同连接关系，但空间排列不同。 [1] 相同元素组成意味着，在对应的同位素组成下，计算精确质量相同；并不意味着碎裂或分离行为一定相同。 简单示例 假想候选物 A、B 具有相同中性分子式和同位素组成，均形成 [M+H] + 。提高质量测量准确度，无法区分它们相同的理论 m/z。色谱方法或诊断碎裂可能将两者区分，但必须证明这种区分能力，不能仅凭技术名称作假设。 常见混淆 按 IUPAC 质谱定义， 同量异位物种（isobars） 的标称质量相同，但精确质量不同。 [2] 它们不必具有相同分子式，也不是异构体的同义词。足够的质量分辨本领可以分开适当的同量异位离子，却不能仅靠精确质量分开同位素组成和电荷均相同的异构体。有些非正式语境把“isobaric”用得更宽泛，因此应说明具体含义。 同位素体 的同位素组成不同，不应与这里讨论的替代结构混淆。应同时记录离子形式及尚未解决的异构类型。 在指南中应用 设计能够区分候选物的实验 区分脂质结构主张

title: Spectral library
summary: Reference spectra and metadata support comparison without making the top hit automatically correct.
text: Definition A spectral library is a collection of reference spectra linked to compound or ion descriptions and acquisition metadata. In small-molecule MS, the reference may be an EI spectrum or an MS/MS spectrum of a specified precursor. Libraries such as MassBank retain chemical and experimental information with their peak lists. [1] Measured and predicted spectra should be labeled distinctly. A simple example A constructed query is positive-mode [M+H] + MS/MS. Before accepting a library hit, check that the reference describes the intended ion and a compatible fragmentation experiment. Compare informative peaks and substantial unexplained signals, not only the displayed rank. Save the library accession, release, preprocessing, tolerances, and scoring method so someone else can reproduce the comparison. Common confusion The highest-scoring entry is the best match among the searched entries under that algorithm; it need not be the correct structure. Missing candidates, similar isomers, and mixed experimental spectra can mislead. A similarity score is not automatically a calibrated probability or an error-rate estimate. An external-library match alone is insufficient for MSI level-1 identification of a known metabolite, which requires comparison with an authentic compound under matching experimental conditions and appropriate orthogonal evidence. [2] Report both the matching evidence and the confidence framework. Use it in a Guide Evaluate spectral matches

title: 谱库
summary: 参考谱与元数据支持比较，但不会使首位命中自动正确。
text: 定义 谱库 是与化合物或离子描述及采集元数据关联的参考谱集合。在小分子质谱中，参考可以是 EI 谱，也可以是指定前体的 MS/MS 谱。MassBank 等谱库将化学和实验信息与峰列表一起保存。 [1] 应明确区分实测谱与预测谱。 简单示例 假设待检索谱为正离子模式的 [M+H] + MS/MS。接受谱库命中前，要检查参考是否对应所需离子和相容的碎裂实验。比较具有信息量的峰及无法解释的重要信号，不要只看显示的排名。保存谱库记录编号、版本、预处理、容差和评分方法，让别人能够复现比较。 常见混淆 最高分条目是在当前算法与检索集合中最匹配的条目，不一定是正确结构。缺失的候选物、相似异构体和混合实验谱都可能误导判断。相似度分数不会自动成为经过校准的概率或错误率估计。 对于已知代谢物，仅凭外部谱库匹配不足以达到 MSI 一级鉴定；该级别要求在相同实验条件下与真实化合物比较，并提供恰当的正交证据。 [2] 应同时报告匹配证据和置信分级体系。 在指南中应用 评估谱图匹配

title: Lipid shorthand notation
summary: Encode the lipid structural details actually established by the experiment.
text: Definition Lipid shorthand notation is a standardized way to describe lipid structures at the level actually supported by the evidence. It combines a class abbreviation with composition and, when established, positional details. The LIPID MAPS hierarchy allows incomplete structural knowledge to be reported explicitly. [1] A simple example For a simple unmodified diacyl phosphatidylcholine, PC 34:1 describes total chain composition. PC 16:0_18:1 adds the individual chains but leaves their sn positions unspecified. PC 16:0/18:1 assigns their sn order. PC 16:0/18:1(9Z) additionally specifies double-bond position and geometry in the 18:1 chain. These are different claims, even when a database maps them to the same illustrative structure. Common confusion An underscore and a slash are not interchangeable formatting choices. Chain composition alone does not justify chain positions; a total unsaturation count does not localize a double bond. The colon count can represent double-bond equivalents in the broader system, and modified or ether-linked lipids need additional notation. Consult the official rules rather than extending the simple PC example by guesswork. [2] Do not import unmeasured details from a database drawing or common name. Keep evidence, annotation specificity, and quantitative aggregation aligned. Use it in a Guide Read the structural hierarchy

title: 脂质简写命名
summary: 编码实验实际建立的脂质结构细节。
text: 定义 脂质简写命名 是一种标准化表达方式，在证据实际支持的层次描述脂质结构。它将类别缩写、组成以及已经确定的位置细节组合起来。LIPID MAPS 的层级体系允许明确报告不完整的结构知识。 [1] 简单示例 对于简单、未经修饰的二酰基磷脂酰胆碱，PC 34:1 描述链总组成；PC 16:0_18:1 增加各条链的信息，但不指定 sn 位置；PC 16:0/18:1 指定 sn 顺序；PC 16:0/18:1(9Z) 进一步指定 18:1 链的双键位置和几何构型。即使数据库将它们映射到同一幅示意结构图，它们仍是不同的主张。 常见混淆 下划线与斜线不是可互换的排版选择。仅有链组成，不能证明链位置；总不饱和数目，也不能定位双键。在更广泛的体系中，冒号后的数目可以表示双键当量；修饰脂质或醚键脂质需要额外标记。应查阅官方规则，不要凭猜测扩展简单 PC 示例。 [2] 不要从数据库结构图或俗名中导入尚未测得的细节。应使证据、注释的结构具体程度及定量汇总层次保持一致。 在指南中应用 理解结构层级

title: Ion mobility
summary: Ion motion through gas under an electric field, with coordinate and condition definitions that matter.
text: Definition Ion mobility describes how an ion moves through a gas under an electric field. Ion mobility spectrometry separates ions using this behavior. [1] In an ideal uniform-field drift experiment, mobility K is drift velocity divided by field strength: K = v d /E. Its units include cm 2 V −1 s −1 . The value belongs to an ion under specified gas and field conditions, not to an isolated neutral chemical name. A simple example In the constructed Guide example, an ion travels 0.100 m through a 10,000 V/m field in 0.0500 s, giving K = 2.00 cm 2 V −1 s −1 . Time spent outside the drift region must be removed before using that equation. A traveling-wave or trapped-ion coordinate requires its own conversion model. Common confusion Arrival time, K, reduced mobility K 0 , inverse reduced mobility, and CCS are not interchangeable axes. Reduced mobility normalizes gas number density to a declared reference; it does not eliminate gas identity, temperature, or field effects. [2] Different isomers may have resolvable mobilities, but overlapping mobilities do not establish equal structures. Specify the ion form, coordinate, units, conditions, and conversion or calibration before making comparisons. Use it in a Guide Connect motion, mobility, and CCS

title: 离子淌度
summary: 离子在电场作用下穿过气体的运动；坐标和条件定义至关重要。
text: 定义 离子淌度 描述离子在电场作用下穿过气体的运动行为。离子淌度谱利用这种行为进行离子分离。 [1] 在理想均匀电场漂移实验中，淌度 K 为漂移速度除以电场强度：K = v d /E。常用单位包括 cm 2 V −1 s −1 。该数值属于指定气体和电场条件下的离子，而不是脱离条件的中性化学名称。 简单示例 在指南的构造实例中，离子在 10,000 V/m 电场下用 0.0500 s 穿过 0.100 m，得到 K = 2.00 cm 2 V −1 s −1 。使用该式前必须扣除漂移区外的时间。行波或捕集离子坐标需要各自的换算模型。 常见混淆 到达时间、K、约化淌度 K 0 、约化淌度倒数及 CCS 不是可互换的坐标。约化淌度将气体数密度归一到声明的参考值，但不能消除气体种类、温度或电场的影响。 [2] 不同异构体可能具有可分辨的淌度，但淌度重叠不能证明结构相同。比较前应说明离子形式、坐标、单位、条件和换算或校准方法。 在指南中应用 联系运动、淌度与 CCS

title: Collision cross section
summary: A model-derived ion–gas collision quantity whose comparability requires specified conditions.
text: Definition In ion mobility MS, collision cross section (CCS, often Ω) is an effective ion–gas collision quantity inferred from mobility using a physical model. It is commonly reported in square ångströms, Å 2 . It reflects interactions with a specified gas and is not a direct geometric surface measurement of the neutral molecule. [1] A simple example A constructed query ion has CCS 202 Å 2 and a candidate reference 200 Å 2 . The difference is +1.0% relative to the reference. That agreement may support a candidate only after checking the ion form, charge, gas, temperature, field regime, measurement method, and uncertainty. Equal units do not make a nitrogen result directly interchangeable with a helium result. Common confusion A small CCS error is not a universal identification threshold. Multiple structures can have similar CCS, and protonated and sodiated forms of one compound are different ions. Standards and cross-laboratory validation can characterize a method's comparability, but cannot guarantee accuracy for every new chemical class or calibration range. [2] Keep the observed mobility coordinate, conversion method, calibrants and reference values where used, and uncertainty alongside CCS. Avoid presenting a predicted CCS as an experimentally measured value. Use it in a Guide Compare CCS measurements responsibly

title: 碰撞截面
summary: 由模型推导的离子–气体碰撞量；可比性需要明确条件。
text: 定义 在离子淌度质谱中， 碰撞截面 （CCS，常记作 Ω）是通过物理模型从淌度推导的有效离子–气体碰撞量，通常以平方埃 Å 2 报告。它反映离子与指定气体的相互作用，不是对中性分子几何表面的直接测量。 [1] 简单示例 假设待测离子的 CCS 为 202 Å 2 ，候选参考值为 200 Å 2 ，相对于参考值的差异为 +1.0%。只有检查离子形式、电荷、气体、温度、电场范围、测量方法及不确定度后，这种一致性才可能支持候选物。单位相同，不会使氮气结果与氦气结果可直接互换。 常见混淆 小的 CCS 误差不是通用鉴定阈值。多个结构可能具有相近 CCS，同一个化合物的质子化与钠加合形式也是不同离子。标准品和跨实验室验证可以表征方法可比性，但不能保证每种新化学类别或校准范围的准确度。 [2] 应随 CCS 一起保存实测淌度坐标、换算方法、所用校准物及参考值和不确定度。不要把预测 CCS 表述为实验测得的数值。 在指南中应用 负责任地比较 CCS 测量
